jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Government Solutions
jobs.description:
**Help Transform the Future of Housing and Urban Planning**
At Archistar, we’re using artificial intelligence to solve one of the world’s biggest challenges: the global housing crisis.


We partner with municipal governments, planning authorities, and property developers to modernize planning systems, streamline development approvals, and accelerate housing delivery through intelligent technology.


Our AI\-powered platform combines spatial analysis, generative design, machine learning, and advanced data visualization to help governments and industry make faster, smarter, and more compliant planning decisions.


As we continue expanding across the United States and North America, we’re looking for an experienced **Senior Project Manager, Government Solutions** based in **Austin, Texas** to lead the successful implementation and delivery of complex enterprise projects for government customers.  

  

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of:

  

* AI and emerging technology
* Government digital transformation
* Urban planning and housing policy
Enterprise SaaS delivery  
* 

You’ll play a critical role in helping governments modernize how cities are planned, approved, and built.

 **The Role**  

  

As a Senior Project Manager at Archistar, you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software implementations for government customers across the United States and North America.


You will serve as the primary delivery lead between customers and internal teams ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer outcomes.


This role requires strong stakeholder management, project governance, and cross\-functional coordination skills. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and external government stakeholders to drive successful implementation outcomes in complex and politically sensitive environments.


We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, technically confident, and experienced navigating enterprise or government delivery environments.

**What You'll be Responsible For** **Project Delivery \& Governance**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise government implementation projects from contract signature through go\-live and post\-implementation support
* Own project scope, timelines, milestones, budgets, risks, and delivery outcomes
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and implementation roadmaps
* Ensure projects are delivered in alignment with contractual commitments and customer expectations

**Customer \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary delivery contact for government customers and strategic partners
* Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders across technical, operational, and executive levels
* Facilitate governance meetings, status updates, and executive reporting
* Manage stakeholder expectations and proactively resolve delivery issues and risks

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Technical teams to translate customer requirements into actionable delivery plans
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment throughout implementation
* Support successful deployment of AI\-powered planning and permitting solutions within customer environments

**Change Management \& Adoption**

* Drive customer readiness activities including stakeholder alignment, process redesign support, training coordination, and end\-user adoption
* Help customers successfully navigate organizational and operational change associated with digital transformation initiatives

**Delivery Operations \& Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor project performance and proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependencies
* Ensure project milestones and customer acceptance criteria are completed to support invoicing and revenue recognition
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery frameworks, implementation methodologies, and operational processes
* Manage multiple concurrent projects across the United States, Canada and Australia

  

**Requirements** **Required Experience**

* 8\+ years of experience in project management, implementation management, or program delivery within a customer\-facing technology environment
* Proven experience delivering enterprise SaaS, software implementation, or digital transformation projects
* Experience managing complex stakeholder environments across multiple teams and seniority levels
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage project risks, timelines, budgets, and competing priorities
* Experience working closely with technical, product, and engineering teams
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects across time zones and distributed teams  
* 

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with local or state government agencies, public\-sector organizations or regulated industries
* Experience supporting organizational change management or large\-scale digital transformation initiatives
* Familiarity with US public\-sector procurement, governance, compliance or technology implementation environments
* Experience within GovTech, PropTech, civic technology, urban planning, infrastructure or smart\-city environments
* Knowledge of permitting, planning, development or land\-use processes is considered a strong advantage

 **Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certifications are highly regarded  
* 

  

  

**Benefits** **Why Join Archistar?**

jobs.title: Digital Customer Success Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an exceptional Digital Customer Success Program Manager to join the Customer Engineering \& Success team at CircleCI. This is a rare hybrid role built for someone with wide\-ranging experience who is equally at home reviewing a CI/CD config file and defining the strategy for a multi\-touch digital program that scales across thousands of customers. You will own the vision, design, and continuous evolution of scalable digital programs for our growth and self\-serve customer segments, driving feature adoption, reducing churn, and converting monthly customers into long\-term annual commitments.



This person brings deep technical fluency in CI/CD and DevOps, a passion for scalable customer programs, and the strategic judgment to navigate complex, cross\-functional challenges at scale. They will serve as the subject matter expert and key decision\-maker connecting our Growth TSM team, CS Ops, Data \& Analytics, and the customers themselves — defining the digital plays that move customers from stuck to successful, and from monthly plans to annual commitments. If you bring seasoned expertise in building and leading programs that actually work because you understand both the product and the customer at depth, this role was made for you.


**About Customer Success at CircleCI**



Customer Success at CircleCI plays a pivotal role with our customers. The team ensures our customers are getting value from our platform, and identifying ways we can help a customer solve business problems. You'll nurture and grow our portfolio of clients and act as a trusted advisor and ambassador for CircleCI.



In terms of growth, we truly believe in the continued development of each new hire. In joining this team, you'll take part in a community that believes in development and promotion from within and as a rapidly growing business, there are a lot of opportunities for progression.


**What you'll do:**


* **Own \& Grow the Digital Revenue Assisted Segment and Self\-Serve:** Define the strategy for and lead the digital Revenue Assisted segment — applying in\-depth evaluation of variable customer data, product signals, and tooling (Vitally, Mode, AI) to build and continuously evolve a fully automated, scalable customer journey. Ensuring programs are scalable to the month\-to\-month segment.
* **Technical Content Development:** Create and maintain a library of technical adoption content including feature demo videos, config optimization templates, migration guides, and best\-practice walkthroughs for CircleCI features such as parallelism, DLC, resource classes, orbs, and test splitting.
* **Program Design \& Optimization:** Own the strategic roadmap for digital programs across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and feature adoption to early disengagement detection and renewal. Exercise independent judgment in selecting methodologies, evaluation criteria, and optimization approaches. Own program analytics end\-to\-end, translating complex, variable engagement signals into measurable business outcomes and actionable program improvements.
* **M2M\-to\-Annual Conversion:** Design and launch CircleCI's first digital conversion program targeting self\-serve customers on monthly Performance plans, building multi\-touch journeys that drive them toward annual Scale commitments and deliver measurable new ARR.
* **Customer Unblocking \& Technical Triage:** Serve as the technical escalation point for digital program\-triggered customer issues, reviewing customer configs proactively to identify optimization opportunities and turning 1:1 troubleshooting patterns into scalable self\-serve resources.
* **AI \& Data\-Driven Programs:** Partner with Data \& Analytics to operationalize churn prediction models into automated Digital CS plays, define requirements for AI\-driven outreach, and evaluate tooling to advance our digital CS capabilities.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Serve as a key cross\-functional leader and subject matter expert, building formal networks with stakeholders across and beyond the CS organization — including Growth TSMs, CS Ops, Support Engineering, Data \& Analytics, Marketing, and Product. Drive alignment on program strategy, surface customer insights that influence company\-level priorities, and ensure digital programs complement rather than duplicate other customer\-facing efforts.


**What we're looking for:**


* **Experience:** Typically 3\+ years in Customer Success, Project Management, Developer Relations, or Technical Account Management at a developer\-tools or DevOps company (or 3\+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3\+ years; equivalent work experience considered). Prior experience coordinating or leading cross\-functional teams or programs is strongly preferred.
* **CI/CD Proficiency:** Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) — you should be able to read a .circleci/config.yml and identify optimization opportunities.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Rater & API Strategy
jobs.description:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1\) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2\) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3\) to protect the whole home.


As a leader in the home services software\-as\-a\-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home\-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.


In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

**Job Title:** Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager

**Location:** United States

**Workplace Type:** Remote

**Job Summary**
---------------


The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager.


Most of Porch's new insurance business flows through the comparative rater channel, making this role a direct driver of written premium growth. As Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and partner relationships for how comparative rating platforms — such as EZLynx, PL Rater, and Bolt — and large directly\-integrated agencies connect into our business. You will serve as the single accountable owner for getting new products, states, and brands live on rater platforms quickly and reliably, migrating legacy point\-to\-point integrations onto our Gateway API, and ensuring every live connection is optimized to maximize new business production. Operating at the intersection of engineering, product, distribution, and external partners, you will also serve as the technical bridge to our Sales and Distribution teams — providing scoping support for strategic prospects and ensuring agents have what they need to capture the rates they're eligible for.

**What You Will Do As A Rater \& Agency Integration Program Manager**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Own the roadmap and drive execution for getting new products, states, and brands live on comparative rater platforms (EZLynx, PL Rater, Bolt, and similar) in a timely fashion, treating launch speed as a direct driver of new business growth.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all rater and direct\-agency integration issues, escalations, and migration requests — triaging, prioritizing, and driving them to resolution across engineering, product, and distribution.
* Own the strategy and roadmap for migrating comparative raters and large directly\-integrated agencies from point\-to\-point connections onto the Gateway API, sequencing migrations by business impact, technical readiness, and risk.
* Partner with the API Product Manager and Engineering Manager to translate launch and migration roadmaps into scoped, sequenced engineering work, ensuring requirements reflect real\-world rater and agency workflows.
* Work closely with Distribution leaders to align launch and migration timing, minimize disruption to active business, and coordinate communication with external partners.
* Run regular, proactive relationship touchpoints with rater partners and large directly\-integrated agencies to surface pain points ahead of escalation, negotiate timelines, and identify opportunities to expand or improve connectivity.
* Join National Partner calls as the technical face of the team — partnering with partner engineers and product teams, and presenting directly to agents, to ensure the best eligible rate is being displayed.
* Define and track program\-level KPIs including time\-to\-live, migration velocity, integration uptime, quote volume, conversion, discount capture rate, rate leakage, and escalation resolution time, reporting progress and risk to leadership.
* Own and maintain the project plan, timelines, and communications around integrations, performance, and risks/issues.
* Audit how connected raters and agencies structure and submit data (fields, defaults, optional attributes) to identify mis\-mapped or missing data that suppresses eligible discounts or defaults to a worse rate, and drive fixes with partners and engineering.
* Partner with Product and Underwriting to stay current on rating\-rule, discount, and eligibility changes, and ensure they are reflected correctly across rater and Gateway integrations.
* Build monitoring and reporting to flag quotes or integrations where data\-quality or mapping issues are suppressing rate competitiveness, and proactively alert Sales/Distribution when a change is detected.
* Establish governance and onboarding standards so new comparative raters or large agencies connect directly to the Gateway API going forward, preventing future integration sprawl.
* Identify and advise leadership on strategic opportunities within the rater and direct\-agency network, including new integration patterns, competitive gaps, and growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Associate Program Manager - Data Center Construction
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.


Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.


Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.


We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is seeking an **Associate Program Manager** to support pre\-lease technical due diligence for a confidential hyperscale data center client. You will work under a Program Manager to keep a portfolio of live deals organized, on track, and moving, while building toward ownership of your own deals.


This is an execution and organization role that builds into program management. You will own the tracking, follow\-up, and day\-to\-day structure across every deal you support, sit in on every deal call as the account's backstop, and progressively take on direct ownership of workstreams and sites as you demonstrate the judgment to run them. Deals move on short exclusivity windows and incomplete information. We are looking for people who bring order to that rather than waiting for it to settle.


Prior program or project coordination experience is expected. Data center, real estate, or construction exposure is a plus but not required. This is not an executive assistant role and not a purely administrative function. It is the operational backbone of the diligence process, and a defined path into full program management.


This role reports to a Program Manager and is based in San Francisco, with other locations and remote considered for the right candidate.

**Responsibilities**

* **Tracking and follow\-up:** Own the action item log across every meeting on your accounts. Assign owners, chase status, and close items out, escalating anything that stalls.
* **Risk log management:** Keep the risk register current for every site in your portfolio. Log new findings, confirm each has an owner and a next step, and follow up until closed.
* **Meeting management:** Build and distribute the agenda ahead of every standing call, keep it on track, and issue a recap and minutes the same day.
* **Deliverable tracking:** Track what is due from consultants and developers across every workstream, and chase it before it is late, not after.
* **Deal awareness and backstop:** Participate in every deal call across your portfolio. Serve as the backstop for each deal, whether you own it or not: know what is happening, what the open issues and risks are, and what needs to happen next. Backstop means knowing it and flagging it, not making the final call on it.
* **Communication and systems:** Keep the shared trackers and communication channels clean, concise, and accurate so the Program Manager, the client, and other account partners can find what they need without asking you first.
* **Client and reporting support:** Draft the first pass of client reports and status updates for the Program Manager to edit, so they are reacting to a draft, not starting from a blank page.

As a Pilot Project Manager supporting the VA's Chief Center for Care and Payment Innovation (CCPI) office within the Strategic Planning Division (SPD) innovation engine aligned with VA Planning, Innovation \& Modernization (PIM), you will lead the planning, execution, and performance tracking of healthcare pilot and innovation programs designed to improve Veterans' health outcomes and care delivery across VA facilities. This role operates at the intersection of federal healthcare policy and operational innovation, requiring close collaboration with VA program offices, senior executive stakeholders, and Congressional reporting chains to advance high\-visibility transformation initiatives.
  
  

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, detail\-oriented project manager who thrives in complex, ambiguous federal healthcare environments and can translate program performance data into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and legislative audiences, especially with regard to the development of data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden.
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

Lead end\-to\-end project management of VA healthcare pilot and innovation efforts, including scope definition, work planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination across program lifecycle phases.
  
  

Develop, maintain, and deliver high\-quality performance reports and program dashboards tailored for Senior Executive Service (SES) review, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with VA strategic priorities.
  
  

Support the preparation of Congressional reporting packages, briefing materials, and responses to data calls, ensuring compliance with federal reporting standards and legislative requirements.
  
  

Facilitate cross\-functional working groups and pilot site coordination meetings, capturing action items, decisions, and risks while driving accountability among internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

Monitor and evaluate pilot program performance metrics against defined success criteria, identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities for course correction or scale\-up recommendations.
  
  

Maintain comprehensive project documentation including charters, schedules, risk registers, lessons\-learned logs, and after\-action reports in accordance with federal contracting and VA documentation standards.
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

Minimum 4 years of project management experience, with demonstrated experience managing healthcare pilot programs, innovation initiatives, or similarly complex multi\-stakeholder engagements.
  
  

Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Public Health, Health Administration, Business Administration, Public Policy, or a related field required.
  
  

Prior experience supporting federal agency clients, VA program offices, or federal healthcare environments strongly preferred; familiarity with VA organizational structure and mission is highly desirable.
  
  

Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation; active clearance or prior federal suitability determination is a plus.
  
  

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship; this position supports a federal government contract and is subject to applicable federal employment eligibility requirements.
  
  

Demonstrated experience developing performance reports, briefing materials, or data packages for senior government leaders (SES\-level or equivalent) and/or Congressional stakeholders.
  
  

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred. \| \- Experience with VA or federal health innovation offices (e.g., VHA Innovation Ecosystem, CMMI, CMTO, or equivalent) is a significant plus. \| \- Familiarity with federal performance management frameworks such as GPRAMA, OMB reporting requirements, or VA MISSION Act implementation. \| \- Experience using VA\-approved collaboration and project tracking tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Teams, or equivalent federal\-compliant platforms). \| \- Prior experience coordinating Congressional data calls, GAO engagements, or IG responses in a federal healthcare contracting context.

Success in this role requires strong project management discipline, exceptional follow through and the ability to keep multiple stakeholders, dependencies and deadlines aligned.

* Build and maintain detailed workback schedules, project timelines and trackers across multiple concurrent launches and workstreams
* Manage day to day project logistics from kickoff through review, approval and final delivery
* Document and consolidate feedback across review rounds, route feedback to the appropriate partners and drive resolution

* Reprioritize work in real time as business needs, deadlines and project requirements shift

* Drive stakeholder accountability and follow through on deliverables and action items
* Partner cross functionally with creative, marketing, developer and other internal teams

**Minimum Qualifications**


* 5 to 8 years of project or program management experience
* Proven experience coordinating with and managing external agencies and vendors
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent launches with competing deadlines
* Strong track record building and maintaining workback schedules, project timelines and trackers
* Experience managing complex cross functional projects across multiple stakeholders and teams
* Ability to proactively identify and resolve risks, blockers and dependencies
* Strong meeting facilitation and written status reporting skills
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools, including Google Workspace or comparable platforms
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail across concurrent projects
* Clear, proactive communication style with demonstrated ability to drive follow through and accountability
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and adapt quickly to shifting priorities


**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: Project Manager (SaaS Implementations)
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed \& Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.


Bullhorn is a fast\-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.


**About the role**

The **Project Manager** is a key position within Professional Services and the PMO and acts with integrity and leads by example, serving as the primary point of contact throughout the customer engagement lifecycle. This role is accountable for ensuring the right resources, governance, and methodologies are in place to enable successful planning, execution, and delivery of complex core SaaS system implementations for our clients, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, on budget, and with high CSAT scores.


In this capacity, the Project Manager partners closely with Customers, Sales Executives, Solution Consultants, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and deliverables align with defined success criteria. By applying project management best practices and adhering to Bullhorn’s PMO processes, the Senior Project Manager defines, drives, and manages the delivery of projects, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder expectations to ensure an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through closure.  

  



**A typical day will include...**
---------------------------------

* **Owning the Project Lifecycle:** Lead the planning, execution, and closure of multiple, concurrent, large\-scale client software implementation projects, establishing the necessary governance and structure where none exists.
* **Proactively Drive Clarity and Order:** Quickly assess and gain command over complex, ambiguous, and high\-risk projects, translating chaos into defined, manageable, and executable project plans.
* **Ultimate Accountability:** Serve as the single point of accountability for project status and success. Naturally take ownership of problems and aggressively drive solutions to resolution.
* **Rigorous Risk and Scope Management:** Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks, dependencies, and issues. Firmly manage scope creep and hold both internal and client stakeholders accountable to agreed\-upon project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Executive\-Level Communicatio** n: Manage client and vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for project status, expectations, and issue resolution with executive and C\-level stakeholders.
* **Financial and Resource Control:** Oversee project budgets, tracking hours and expenses to ensure financial targets are met and providing accurate, predictable and insightful forecasting and reporting.
* **Methodology Adherence:** Apply project management best practices and actively contribute to the development, improvement and standardization of Bullhorn's PMO processes.
* Mentoring and provide guidance to junior project managers or implementation specialists on best practices and project governance.

**This role is a fit for you if...**
------------------------------------

* Have 3\+ years of progressive experience managing complex, external client\-facing software implementation projects, with a significant focus on ERP, HCM, CRM, or large\-scale SaaS solutions with billable utilization targets.
* A proven track record of successfully delivering projects that have a high level of complexity and ambiguity, demonstrating the ability to rapidly impose structure and governance.
* An expertise in defining and managing project scope, schedules, and budgets for large enterprise clients.
* A mastery of various project management methodologies ( *e.g.,* Waterfall, Scrum, Hybrid) and knowing when to apply each to achieve stability.
* A solid understanding of the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, integration, testing (UAT), and go\-live.
* Have a proficiency with modern project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, SmartSheet) and resource management systems.
* PMP, CSM, or equivalent is highly preferred.

The annual base salary range for this position is $92,002 \- $115,000\. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target bonus \& a comprehensive benefits package.


**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About MonetizeMore**
----------------------


MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture\-first organization driven by four core values: **Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen** (Continuous Improvement), and **Collaboration**. We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.

  

**About the Role**
------------------


The company is seeking an experienced, systems\-driven **Business Operations Manager** to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end\-to\-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.  

  

The **Business Operations Manager** will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross\-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization\-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data\- and AI\-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.

  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **1\. Process Kaizen \& SOP Governance**

* ### **Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.**

### **2\. Project Management \& Visibility**

* ### **Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to\-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company\-wide model with long\-term integration into BL L10s.**

### **3\. Product Rollout Support**

* ### **Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go\-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model.**

### **4\. Cross\-Departmental \& Enterprise Client Enablement**

* ### **Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross\-functional commitments visible and actioned.**

### **5\. Data \& Spreadsheet Management**

* ### **Own data pulls and spreadsheet\-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re\-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental.**


**Who You Are**
---------------

* **The Experienced Operator:** You have 4\+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high\-data\-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).
* **The Systems Builder:** You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.
* **Data\- and AI\-Fluent:** You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand\-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity:** You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.
* **Direct Communicator:** You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **True Flexibility:** Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle.
* **Professional Development:** Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company.

jobs.description:
**About** MelodyArc


MelodyArc is building the orchestration layer for enterprise service work — where rules, people, and AI collaborate to get complex operations done reliably at scale. Our orchestration core (the Point Engine) enables teams to configure agentic AI Operators that execute work end\-to\-end while leveraging existing business logic and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.


**Role Overview**


A MelodyArc Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) runs delivery for a core area of the platform. You build the plan, drive technical design to closure with engineering, clear blockers, and hold the launch gate. Product owns strategy, roadmap, and requirements; you own the plan that delivers them.


The work is technical. You read the design doc, find the dependency nobody raised, trace the integration that keeps failing, and query the telemetry yourself. You operate across engineering, Deployment Strategists, and customer teams, inside live enterprise deployments where reliability, security, and adoption are the bar.


**The Impact You Will Have**


* **Program plan and critical path:** Own the delivery plan for a core product area. Map dependencies across engineering, deployment, and customer teams. Sequence milestones, track the critical path, and hold teams to dates.


* **Technical design:** Drive the technical design review to closure with engineering. Reason about APIs, webhooks, event flows, data contracts, permissions, reliability, and observability.


* **Unblocking:** Run down integration failures, environment issues, data access, third\-party dependencies, and cross\-team conflicts. Escalate with a recommendation, not a status.


* **Release readiness:** Define readiness criteria and launch gates with Product and engineering. Own rollout plans, staged deployment, rollback paths, and go/no\-go.


* **Evaluation and defect flow:** Stand up the feedback loop for agentic workflows. Route task outcomes, transcripts, exceptions, and user feedback into triage, and drive defects to closure against the quality bar Product sets.


* **Instrumented execution:** Use SQL and telemetry to track delivery health, adoption, and regression. Report from data.


* **Communication:** Own status to leadership and customers. Surface risk early with options and a recommendation.


* **Scale impact:** Contribute reusable delivery patterns, templates, and operating practices, and channel field feedback to Product.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 8\+ years in technical program management, delivery leadership, or software engineering, including ownership of enterprise or platform releases.


* A substantial hands\-on technical foundation. You can independently write and read SQL, work with JSON and APIs, understand webhooks and event\-driven integrations, inspect code when needed, and build or modify lightweight prototypes. Experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable tooling is strongly relevant.


* Track record driving programs from design review through production in environments where reliability, data quality, security, and latency matter.


* Experience delivering AI or ML systems into production. You treat evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop design as delivery scope.


* Command of dependency management, risk tracking, and escalation.


* Comfort working directly with customer technical teams and business operators. You can build trust with senior leaders while also getting specific enough with practitioners to understand what is really happening.


* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You bring structure to ambiguity, make technical choices legible to non\-technical stakeholders, and create alignment without waiting for every detail to be handed to you.


* A high\-ownership, low\-ego working style. You enjoy moving between planning and detailed execution, and you do not let an important deliverable stall because it sits outside a narrow job description.


* Based in the United States with professional working proficiency in English.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with agentic AI products, LLM evaluation, or production systems combining automation with human review.


* Experience delivering on configurable, multi\-tenant platforms or complex enterprise integrations.


* Domain experience in customer service operations, contact\-center technology, or other high\-volume business\-process operations.


* Experience supporting customer deployments, technical integrations, or forward\-deployed work.


* Secure SDLC practices aligned with SOC 2 Type II or similar.


* Prior founder, early\-team, or top\-tier consultancy experience.


**Location**


Remote (United States). Some travel to customer sites may be required.

**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


The Pharmacy Fraud Program Manager is a member of the Special Investigations Unit responsible for detecting, validating, and investigating suspected fraudulent activity within the pharmacy benefit — including prescribing, dispensing, and pharmacy claims activity — across a wide range of internal and external data sources. This role centers on rigorous data validation — reconciling, cross\-referencing, and stress\-testing information drawn from numerous systems to confirm accuracy, surface inconsistencies, and build defensible investigative findings.


The ideal candidate pairs a deeply inquisitive, investigative mindset with strong analytical discipline and brings genuine pharmacy depth: fluency with pharmacy claims data and pharmacy benefit operations, including NCPDP claim fields, NDCs, quantity and days supply logic, formulary and prior authorization concepts, and prescriber and pharmacy identifiers (NPI, DEA, state license), together with a working knowledge of the regulatory framework governing pharmacy fraud, waste, and abuse.


They are fluent in recognizing pharmacy fraud triggers and red flags — prescribing and dispensing outliers, controlled substance and overutilization patterns, and pharmacy billing schemes — and they actively leverage AI\-assisted detection and validation tools to scale their analysis, prioritize cases, and reduce false positives. This person is comfortable asking hard questions, following the data wherever it leads, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable conclusions.


In addition to the core responsibilities of the Fraud Program Manager role, this position serves as the primary owner of the CFWA relationship with our pharmacy benefit manager, coordinating referrals, reporting, and oversight activities between the organization and CVS. This person will work side by side with the Fraud Program Manager on overall fraud detection and scheme identification.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

**CFWA Relationship Management — CVS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the CFWA program with CVS, managing day\-to\-day coordination, escalations, and information exchange.
* Manage the intake, routing, and disposition of CFWA referrals to and from CVS, tracking each referral through resolution and ensuring turnaround times and documentation standards are met.

* Monitor CVS performance against contractual, delegated, and regulatory FWA obligations; identify gaps, request corrective action, and escalate deficiencies to compliance and leadership.
* Track pharmacy\-level actions performed by CVS under the PBM agreement — including pharmacy audits, prepayment review, claim edits, recoveries, and network termination — confirming that agreed actions were taken and applied correctly, and escalating where they were not.

**Data Validation \& Source Reconciliation**

* Validate, reconcile, and cross\-reference data drawn from numerous and disparate sources — pharmacy and medical claims systems, PBM data feeds, prior authorization and rejected\-claim data, eligibility and enrollment systems, prescriber and pharmacy provider files, third\-party databases, public records, watchlists, internal applications, and external vendor feeds.
* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across data sets — including NDC, quantity, days supply, DAW, prescriber NPI, DEA number, and dispensing pharmacy mismatches — and determine whether they indicate error, manipulation, or fraud.
* Establish and maintain data integrity standards for investigations, ensuring findings are accurate, complete, and defensible.
* Trace data lineage across internal systems and PBM\-supplied files, corroborating information against authoritative sources to confirm or refute investigative hypotheses.

**AI\-Assisted Detection \& Validation**

* Use AI\- and machine learning–driven detection tools to flag suspicious patterns, score risk, and surface high\-priority cases for review.
* Validate AI\-generated alerts and model outputs against source claims and clinical data, distinguishing genuine fraud indicators from false positives, data artifacts, and legitimate clinical variation.
* Provide structured feedback to analytics, vendor, and PBM partners to improve model accuracy, tuning, and rule logic over time.
* Stay current on emerging AI\-enabled fraud schemes (e.g., synthetic identities, deepfakes, generated prescriptions or prior authorization documentation, fraudulent e\-prescribing credentials) and adapt detection approaches accordingly.

**Pharmacy Fraud Detection, Triggers \& Red Flags**

* Apply deep knowledge of pharmacy fraud triggers, red flags, and typologies — including prescribing and dispensing patterns — to proactively identify suspicious activity before it escalates.
* Develop, refine, and document indicators and detection criteria based on emerging schemes and investigative learnings.
* Investigate referrals and self\-sourced leads, building complete case referrals supported by validated evidence.

**About Perfected**

When corporations cause harm, someone has to answer for it. At Perfected, we guide people through complex legal journeys with one clear goal: to hold corporations accountable and help communities reclaim their power.


We start with people—their stories, their pain, their hope—and we stand with them every step of the way. Our work is rooted in transparency, empathy, and advocacy. Our preference is for applicants located \- or willing and able to work \- in the Pacific or Mountain time zones.

jobs.title: Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
**About Us**


At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

**Position Summary**


We are seeking a Data Analyst II to own recurring reporting and ad hoc analysis for an assigned manufacturer program or internal domain, becoming the person who knows that program's enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and data sources deeply. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data \& Analyticsdepartment and reports to the Manager, Analytics \& Reporting, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards.


Depth in one program or domain beats a thin layer across many, especially in the first year. This role has no direct reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own one manufacturer program or internal domain deeply: its enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and where its data comes from and lives.
* Own recurring reporting that goes out on a schedule: weekly and monthly program reporting plus support for daily feeds, reviewing numbers before they leave and raising unexplained changes rather than shipping them.
* Answer questions with a deadline attached by tracing them through claim adjudication, prior authorization status, prescription state changes, and fulfillment records, returning an answer plus your confidence in it.
* Write down metric definitions when you settle a disagreement for your program, keep reporting consistent with them, and document them where the next person will find them.
* Build dashboards in Looker, our primary BI platform (Metabase also in use, migrating off Domo), including client\-facing Looker work that is still being stood up, and raise a dbt model request when logic belongs in the warehouse rather than in a dashboard tile.
* Handle PHI carefully as a daily practice: know what your access covers, use the minimum you need, and ask before moving patient\-level data anywhere new.

**Qualifications**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree preferred; not required. We evaluate demonstrated capability rather than credentials.
* **Licensure/Certification**: Not applicable.
* **Experience**: Typically 2 to 4 years of experience in data analysis. This band is guidance rather than a gate.
* **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**:
	+ Can take a vague question, sharpen it into something answerable, and come back with the answer and its caveats without needing to be checked on daily.
	+ Validates work: counts rows, compares against a second source, and asks why a total does not tie before anyone else has to ask.
	+ Writes and speaks plainly about what you found, so someone in an account or operations role can read your summary and act on it.
	+ Comfortable being told a number is wrong: finds out why and says so rather than quietly patching it, and is curious about how the healthcare and pharmacy operation actually works.
	+ A couple of years of analysis work where SQL was the main tool: you can write more than a simple join, including window functions and careful aggregation, and you take the time to figure out grain before writing anything.
	+ Demonstrated application of the above Qualification
	+ Nice to have: pharmacy, claims, or payer data experience (prior authorizations, adjudication, benefit verification, NDCs, dispensing workflows); dbt experience contributing transformation logic rather than only reading from it; Looker or LookML exposure; Snowflake (we are mid\-migration from PostgreSQL); Python for analysis that does not fit in SQL; or experience producing work that went to an external client.

**Work Environment**

* **Location**: Columbus, OH or Remote (US).
* **Schedule**: Full\-time; standard business hours.
* May require flexibility around reporting deadlines tied to weekly, monthly, and daily program feeds.
* Regular collaboration with account and operations teams and manufacturer program contacts, plus time on the distribution center floor and with the call center to understand the operation firsthand.

**Key Essential Functions**

* Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods
* Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with account and operations stakeholders
* Must be able to handle and access data in compliance with HIPAA and PHI handling requirements
* Must be able to periodically visit the distribution center and call center to observe operations firsthand

**Employment Classification**

**Status:** Full\-time
  

**FLSA:** Exempt

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**


Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.


We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply!

**Disclaimer**


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
* Develop and deliver training and change\-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow\-up resources.
* Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first\-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality\-of\-hire measurement efforts.
* Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross\-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)**


Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
* Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
* Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
* Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is a global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across diverse industries. Our mission is clear: *to help make your world a safer place*. With a strong legacy of trust, innovation, and global expertise, we design and deliver tailored security programs that combine cutting\-edge technology with exceptional service.

 **Position: Senior Regional Program Manager – Security**  

**Location: Onsite at client facility, Manhattan, NY**

  

The Senior Regional Program Manager (SRPM) is the client’s primary Security Advisor and strategic partner, responsible for the overall security program across the assigned regional portfolio. This role owns the account strategy end\-to\-end, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive security program that aligns Securitas and client objectives.

  

The SRPM drives program performance, profitability, and consistency across all locations, ensuring a scalable and sustainable security posture. A core focus is proactive risk management, identifying issues early, implementing forward\-looking recommendations, and preventing recurrence through robust processes, standards, and controls.

**Compensation and Benefits**


Securitas offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package. Based on experience, the starting salary range for this role is **$150,000–$156,000**, plus a full benefits program that includes:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 10 accrued vacation days, 4 floating holidays, and 6 sick days
* Monthly parking provided
* Bonus eligible

**Core Responsibilities**


The Senior Regional Program Manager leads and/or directly completes tasks in the following areas:

* **Client Relationship \& Program Leadership**
	+ Serve as the key point of contact and trusted Security Advisor for the client.
	+ Drive continuous improvement and evolution of the regional security program, ensuring alignment with client risk appetite and business priorities.
* **P\&L Ownership \& Performance Management**
	+ Maintain full profit and loss (P\&L) responsibility for the assigned account.
	+ Analyze operational and financial indicators to optimize performance, efficiency, and value delivery.
* **Executive Coordination \& Service Quality**
	+ Coordinate account activity and regularly brief the Global Clients Americas (GCA) Vice President.
	+ Implement programs and initiatives, monitor service quality, and initiate timely corrective actions where needed.
* **Security Risk Reviews \& Safety Programs**
	+ Lead and perform Security Risk Reviews of client facilities using industry best practices and client\-specific assessment tools.
	+ Implement and manage global safety programs; coordinate with the client to support special events, incidents, and emergency coverage.
* **Branch Alignment \& Customer Service Excellence**
	+ Ensure branches maintain a consistent focus on high\-quality customer service and risk\-aware operations.
	+ Provide guidance to support retention and growth of profitable business.
* **Staffing Strategy \& Workforce Management**
	+ Ensure appropriate staffing levels in collaboration with area management.
	+ Oversee scheduling to meet client requirements while controlling labor costs.
	+ Build strong teams, foster collaboration, and lead the implementation of progressive changes.
* **Governance, Transitions \& Contract Compliance**
	+ Conduct regular account reviews with client and Securitas leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Credit & Lending
jobs.description:
Mercury is building Mercury Bank, N.A., a proposed nationally chartered bank focused on serving ambitious businesses. Credit and lending are central to that mission, and as we migrate our charge card and term loan products to the Bank's own balance sheet and build the next generation of lending infrastructure, we need someone who can hold the full program together.



The Senior Technical Program Manager for Credit and Lending will own end\-to\-end delivery of the technology programs that power Mercury's charge card, term loan, and adjacent credit products. You will be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations: setting strategy for how these programs run, surfacing tradeoffs that unblock leaders, sequencing the critical path, and ensuring that what ships is audit\-ready from day one.



We are looking for someone who has operated at this level before, in a regulated environment, at scale, with real accountability for outcomes.


* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC\-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*


### **What you'll do:**


#### **Program ownership**


* Own the integrated program plan across all active credit and lending workstreams, covering milestones, dependencies, and critical paths across Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations.
* Proactively manage sequencing, resourcing tradeoffs, and escalations. When initiatives are off\-track, you identify it first and bring a recommended path forward.
* Ensure Compliance, Treasury, and Operations readiness lands alongside product and regulatory milestones
* Drive incident learnings back into design, test coverage, and runbooks so each issue improves the underlying system, not just fixes the symptom.
* Contribute to the overall (proposed) Mercury Bank, NA technical program, collaborating with other TPMs to build a holistic view of progress and risks

#### **Governance and decision\-making**


* Keep a single source of truth for status, decisions, risks, and owners. Maintain a living RAID log with clear owners and impact assessments.
* Facilitate structured decision\-making by surfacing options and tradeoffs to leaders before problems escalate.
* Build and improve the operating systems that drive credit and lending product decisions: planning cycles, reviews, decision frameworks, launch readiness.

#### **Communication and influence**


* Produce concise, predictable updates calibrated to the audience.
* Synthesize complex cross\-functional information into recommendations that help executives decide and move.
* Produce documentation of program objectives, architecture decisions, and operational impacts that onboards new team members without requiring a meeting to explain it.
* Function as a trusted thought partner to engineering leads, product managers, and senior leadership.

#### **Execution and improvement**


* Identify inefficiencies and eliminate them through automation, AI tooling, or process redesign.
* Lead technical retrospectives and post\-mortems, ensuring learnings are systematized rather than forgotten.

### **What we're looking for:**


#### **Experience**


* 10\+ years of program management or technical program management in a high\-growth or regulated environment.
* Direct experience in financial services, fintech, or credit infrastructure. Compliance, audit, reporting and risk management obligations are familiar territory.
* Track record of operating at the department or business level, owning programs with multiple concurrent workstreams and cross\-functional accountability.
* Proven ability to communicate with and influence executive stakeholders, in writing and in high\-stakes meetings, without a senior manager to translate.
* Bonus: Familiarity with the lending tooling ecosystem such as loan origination, credit risk management and lending management systems.

#### **How you work**


* Product\-first. You evaluate everything through: what is the user problem, what is the fastest path to learning, what actually moves the needle.
* AI\-native. You use AI tools to do your actual work. You have built workflows or tooling that changed how your team operates. When you see a repetitive process, you automate it.
* Comfortable in ambiguity. You build structure where there is none.
* Systems thinker. You see dependencies, second\-order effects, and points of failure before they surface, and you build programs that account for them.
* Energized by building and operating. You do your best work designing the system and running it well once it is built.

### **What you bring:**


* Technical fluency. You can understand and challenge engineering decisions, identify technical risks early, and translate complexity for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You write documentation that clarifies hard decisions and build frameworks teams actually adopt.
* Commercial instincts. You understand the financial dynamics of a lending business well enough to evaluate tradeoffs with authority.
* High emotional intelligence. You build trust quickly across engineering, product, risk, and executive stakeholders. You navigate complex interpersonal situations without losing credibility or momentum.

You’ll help guide cross\-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision\-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment, strategic foresight, and the ability to operate across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large\-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject\-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.

* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI\-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high\-pressure, high\-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Amazon Freight
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon spent decades building one of the best supply chains in the world to run its own business, moving, storing, and delivering products fast and reliably. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) now opens that same network up to other businesses, so any company can use Amazon's multimodal ground and air freight, warehousing, distribution \& fulfillment, and parcel shipping to run their own operations. Think of it like what AWS did for cloud computing, but for supply chain, and it is just getting started.
  

  

We're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to turn ASCS's data into decisions – you don't just report what happened — you crisply explain why it happened, what it means for the business, and what we should do differently tomorrow. You'll dig into complex, messy datasets, build the dashboards and pipelines that make performance visible, and deliver the insight that changes what leadership prioritizes next. The role spans strategic and tactical work — from defining the analytical framework to writing the query yourself. It's highly visible, cross\-functional, and not for someone who wants a narrow lane.  

  

The ideal candidate will be a sharp SQL and BI practitioner who builds things that scale, translates ambiguity into structure, and transforms data into narratives that drive action. You are comfortable embracing ambiguity, translating multi\-channel performance data into a clear narrative, and changing a stakeholder's mind with evidence rather than opinion. You work backward from the customer, you dive deep rather than accepting the first plausible explanation, and you'd rather build a scalable solution once than answer the same ad hoc question five times.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Turn operational and performance data into insights and narratives leadership can act on — not just charts, the "so what."
* Work with large, complex, sometimes\-ugly datasets using the right tool for the job, whether that's SQL, Python, or a spreadsheet.
* Partner with Product, Program, Engineering, and Sales to define data requirements and build BI solutions that actually get used, not just launched.
* Build and own self\-serve analytics — dashboards, drill\-downs, alerts, and metric definitions — so performance is obvious at a glance across ASCS service lines.
* Define measurement frameworks that connect acquisition, engagement, and operational KPIs, and run retrospectives that end in specific optimization actions, not just observations.
* Identify what's actually driving key metrics, quantify the impact, and make the call on where the business should invest next.
* Build automated pipelines and reporting that cut manual effort and speed up decisions.
* Mentor junior analysts on technique, problem\-solving, and how to land a recommendation with a room full of stakeholders.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Power BI experience
* 7\+ years of business or financial analysis, product costing, procurement, or a quantitative role experience
* 5\+ years of Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) experience
* Experience applying basic statistical methods (e.g. regression) to difficult business problems
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
* Interest in exploring how automation and AI can power workflows, dashboards, and campaigns
