jobs.title: Program Manager I
jobs.description:
Job Description:  

Alutiiq is hiring a Contractor Program Manager to lead operations and maintenance of the Ground\-based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) system for the 15th Space Surveillance Squadron under Mission Delta 2\. GEODSS detects, tracks, identifies, and reports on man\-made objects in Earth orbit, feeding the National Space Defense Center, the 18th Space Defense Squadron, and the National Space Intelligence Center. The system operates from three geographically separated detachments — Stallion Range at White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico, Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia, and Mount Haleakala on Maui — each running three one\-meter telescopes on a 24/7 basis, with mission operations conducted between civil sunset and sunrise.


You will be the single point of accountability to the Government Program Manager, Contracting Officer, and site Contracting Officer Representatives for the performance of the entire program. This is a designated key personnel position; the Government reviews and approves the qualifications package for this role, and any change to the incumbent requires a replacement package within seven days.

  


What You’ll Do
--------------


* Serve as the contractor’s single point of authority for GEODSS O\&M across all three detachments, reporting any problem affecting requirement accomplishment or contractor performance to the CORs, Government PM, and CO within one business day
* Own the program Management Plan — organizational structure, lines of authority, manning levels, position descriptions, qualification and certification requirements, training approach, work scheduling, and integration with the Quality Management Program
* Direct the three Site Managers and the program\-level functional leads for system administration, line tactics, environmental, civil engineering, weapon system maintenance, and logistics/transportation
* Maintain staffing continuity: keep vacancies under 60 calendar days, submit a Vacancy Fill Plan within three business days of any vacancy, and deliver an updated organizational chart within five business days of each new hire
* Drive performance against the contract’s measured objectives — monthly completion rates for SOI, maneuver, Category I, and cislunar taskings; sensor availability of no less than 99% per month; and zero reportable COMSEC or security incidents
* Oversee the Quality Program and Quality Program Plan, keeping the quality function organizationally independent of operational and technical management, and ensure timely Site Quality Status Reports
* Represent the program at the weekly IPT, bi\-weekly MFT status meetings, the annual Program Management Review, the annual GEODSS PIWG, and Space Domain Awareness forums
* Lead contract transition and phase\-in, including staffing, clearance initiation, property inventories, and phase\-out planning
* Manage execution of cost\-reimbursable travel and local purchase line items, develop budget inputs, and prepare unfunded requirement justifications with impact statements
* Own contingency planning and crisis response across the three sites, including natural disasters, work stoppages, and site evacuations
* Develop technical and cost proposals for Individual Job Orders at the request of the Contracting Officer
* Maintain the program’s cybersecurity and CMMC compliance posture and oversee all contract deliverables

  



  

  

Required Qualifications
-----------------------


* Active Top Secret clearance with SCI access
* U.S. Citizenship
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, management, or a related discipline, plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years managing DoD operations and maintenance or mission operations service contracts \[Alutiiq to confirm minimums against the Labor Categorization Tool skill level of Senior]
* Demonstrated experience as the accountable program or site manager on a firm\-fixed\-price Government services contract with measured performance objectives
* Experience managing a workforce covered by a collective bargaining agreement — two of the three GEODSS sites are represented by the IBEW
* Experience managing geographically separated operations, including remote or OCONUS locations
* Track record of on\-time Government deliverable submission and favorable CPARS ratings
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to brief senior Government audiences
* Willingness and ability to travel to Socorro, New Mexico and to Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory

  




Preferred Qualifications
------------------------


* Direct experience with GEODSS, the Space Surveillance Network, or comparable optical or radar sensor sites
* Background in space domain awareness, space surveillance, or satellite ground systems operations
* Prior support to 15 SPSS, Mission Delta 2, Space Systems Command, or predecessor organizations
* Experience leading a contract transition or phase\-in on a recompete
* Familiarity with IMDS, JDRS, AF Form 1067 modification processes, and Air Force technical order systems
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* Master’s degree in a technical or management discipline

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**

This isn't a desk job; it's a front\-row seat to shaping how the U.S. military postures, moves, and sustains forces across the Pacific theater. As a Logistics Operations Analyst at Camp Smith, you'll translate complex engineering requirements and operational priorities into decisions that matter, delivering planning products and assessments directly to senior military and civilian leaders. You'll work at the intersection of joint logistics, engineering operations, and theater\-level planning, where your analysis drives real outcomes across a vast and contested region. If you thrive in high\-stakes environments and want your work to count, this is where you belong.

**THE MISSION**

The Pacific theater demands precision, adaptability, and deep operational know\-how. K2 is looking for a Logistics Operations Analyst to support a joint logistics and engineering organization at Camp Smith, Honolulu, HI. You'll analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, and logistics dependencies, then turn that analysis into actionable products for decision\-makers. From deliberate planning to real\-world contingency operations, your work directly supports theater readiness, force posture, and engineering integration across Service components and regional partners.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, access limitations, and logistics dependencies affecting engineering support across the Pacific
* Attend operational briefs, OPGs, planning sessions, and coordination meetings — independently capture decisions, taskings, risks, and follow\-up actions
* Translate engineering guidance and operational priorities into concise planning inputs, logistics assessments, staff products, and recommendations
* Coordinate with engineering, logistics, planning, and operations personnel across the joint force and Service components
* Support integration of engineering requirements into CONPLANs, OPLANs, contingency plans, exercise plans, and related operational products
* Assess the feasibility and supportability of force posture, basing, infrastructure, and sustainment concepts
* Develop briefings, decision papers, executive summaries, readiness updates, trackers, and other products for senior military and civilian leaders
* Support exercise operations and real\-world planning activities, including participation in a shift\-work environment when required
* Maintain planning processes, status trackers, readiness indicators, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility of engineering and logistics requirements
* Provide lessons learned and post\-event recommendations to improve future planning and operational execution
* Plan, track, and coordinate movement of Class IV materials — sandbags, barbed wire, lumber, concrete, and comparable construction and barrier materials — through TRANSCOM, DLA, military distribution, or similar logistics channels
* Translate engineering requirements, including BDA, ADR, PDR, and FP considerations, into prioritized logistics assessments, movement actions, and clear operational briefings

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, operations research, architecture, military studies, national security studies, regional planning, or a related field
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in joint military planning, operational logistics, engineering operations, infrastructure assessment, force posture analysis, or defense planning support
* Demonstrated experience supporting DoD, Combatant Command, Service component, defense agency, or comparable military planning environments
* Working knowledge of joint planning processes, operational design, plan assessment, and staff integration across deliberate and crisis action planning
* Strong analytical and note\-taking skills, including the ability to understand construction properties and communicate technically accurate information to the broader team
* Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, particularly when attending briefs, OPGs, and other senior\-level planning forums
* Solid understanding of Pacific geography, regional access constraints, and the operating environment involving U.S. allies and partners
* Familiarity with joint operations, Priority of Effort, and the integration of engineering support across Service components
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Family****:**


IT Project Management **Travel Required****:**


None **Clearance Required****:**


Ability to Obtain Public Trust
The Technical Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technical initiatives supporting the GrantSolutions contract. Efforts may include application and platform modernization, system enhancements, new capabilities, integrations, cloud adoption, cybersecurity initiatives, and operational improvements. The role requires strong project leadership and sufficient familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Java\-based applications to engage technical teams, understand delivery dependencies and risks, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. The Technical Project Manager will coordinate cross\-functional and multi\-vendor teams; manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, dependencies, and change; and partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, engineering and operations leads, executive leadership, and Federal stakeholders to achieve measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Do****:**


We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead a diverse portfolio of technical efforts, including modernization initiatives, system and application enhancements, new capability delivery, platform improvements, integrations, and technology upgrades. This role will manage delivery from initiation through deployment and transition to operations, coordinating work across multiple workstreams, vendors, and agile teams while maintaining service continuity and alignment with business priorities.


The Technical Project Manager will establish delivery baselines and governance, manage requirements and change, track performance and financials, facilitate technical and business decisions, and coordinate quality, security, release, operational readiness, and stakeholder adoption. This individual will support initiatives involving cloud\-hosted applications, integrations, shared services, data exchanges, infrastructure, and emerging capabilities. Success requires sound judgment, technical curiosity, concise executive communication, and the ability to create accountability without displacing the responsibilities of Product Owners, Scrum Masters, architects, or Technical Leads.

* Lead projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, transition to operations, and closeout, with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Define and maintain project charters, scope, objectives, work breakdown structures, integrated schedules, resource plans, budgets, delivery roadmaps, and governance cadence.
* Manage day\-to\-day execution across multiple agile teams, technical workstreams, vendors, and shared services; clarify roles, commitments, interfaces, and decision rights.
* Partner with Product Owners and technical leads to translate business and technical requirements into prioritized, achievable release plans while maintaining traceability from objectives through delivered capabilities.
* Manage scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, procurement and vendor commitments, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and corrective actions using appropriate controls.
* Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, burn rates, variance analysis, Estimate at Completion, Estimate to Complete, and timely escalation of financial risks.
* Establish and administer integrated change control, assessing proposed changes for business value and impacts to architecture, scope, cost, schedule, security, operations, and contractual commitments.
* Coordinate architecture, application development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, data, testing, configuration management, and operations stakeholders to meet delivery and governance requirements.
* Drive release and operational readiness, including environment and integration dependencies, test completion, defect disposition, data migration, deployment planning, rollback and contingency planning, training, communications, support readiness, and production handoff.
* Track technical dependencies across applications, cloud services, APIs, data exchanges, security components, environments, and shared platform capabilities.
* Coordinate delivery planning for AWS\-hosted environments and Java\-based applications, working with technical leads to understand architecture, security, integration, deployment, and operational considerations.
* Proactively manage implementation and transition risks, including workflow continuity, system\-of\-record decisions, overlapping capabilities, data synchronization, technical debt, testing scope, deployment sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Define and monitor delivery metrics and key performance indicators, such as milestone performance, forecast accuracy, throughput, cycle time, quality trends, defect leakage, dependency aging, and risk exposure; use data to drive recovery plans and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise executive dashboards, weekly and monthly status reports, decision briefs, and forecasts that clearly communicate progress, financial status, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions required.
* Facilitate planning sessions, technical reviews, risk reviews, stakeholder forums, retrospectives, and decision meetings; document actions, owners, due dates, and outcomes.
* Manage vendor performance against plans, deliverables, service expectations, quality criteria, and contractual obligations, escalating gaps and coordinating remediation.
* Maintain complete, audit\-ready project records, including baselines, plans, RAID logs, decisions, approvals, change records, status reports, meeting outcomes, and lessons learned.
* Build trusted relationships across Federal stakeholders, vendors, architects, delivery teams, and operations partners while promoting accountability, constructive conflict resolution

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F\-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst,** F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.


You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.


In this role, you will:


* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross\-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F\-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F\-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P\&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105\.65\-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
	+ OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000\.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530\.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT\&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105

jobs.description:
Horizon Farm Credit is actively recruiting for a Full Stack Analytics Developer, internally referred to as a Business Intelligence Analyst, to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional who enjoys combining application development, business intelligence, analytics, and user experience design to deliver solutions that drive efficiency and business value.


In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data professionals, and technology teams, the Full Stack Analytics Developer will build scalable applications, develop data models and reporting solutions, create intuitive user experiences, and support the organization's growing data\-driven culture. Qualified candidate may work in any available HFC branch location. To view locations, click here Locations \| Horizon Farm Credit . The hours of operation are typically, Monday to Friday from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. This position is eligible for hybrid work schedule.


**Key Responsibilities** **Application Development**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain web\-based business applications.
* Create front\-end user interfaces using modern development frameworks and best practices.
* Develop back\-end services, APIs, and integrations to support business processes.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application issues while continuously improving performance and usability.

**Data \& Analytics**

* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database solutions.
* Design and support data models that enable efficient reporting and analytics.
* Collaborate with Business Intelligence teammates, analysts, and business teams to understand and fulfill reporting requirements.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across solutions.

**Business Intelligence \& Reporting**

* Design and develop Power BI reports, dashboards, and visual analytics solutions.
* Create meaningful visualizations that help users identify trends, insights, and opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into actionable metrics and performance indicators.
* Support users with report enhancements and ongoing analytics needs.

**User Experience (UX) Design**

* Design intuitive and user\-friendly application interfaces.
* Conduct user research and gather feedback to improve usability.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and workflow designs for new applications.
* Apply UX and accessibility best practices to improve user adoption and satisfaction.

**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Document technical solutions, processes, and development standards.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices.
* Stay current on emerging technologies, development tools, and analytics capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Generally, 0 to 5 years of experience in software development, analytics, business intelligence, or related technical roles.
* Experience with SQL and relational database concepts.
* Experience developing Power BI dashboards and reports.
* Experience with Python development and scripting.
* Understanding of web application development concepts and modern development frameworks.
* Knowledge of UX design principles and user\-centered design practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, or similar front\-end frameworks.
* Experience developing APIs and back\-end services.
* Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS and on\-prem solution development.
* Experience integrating multiple data sources and business systems.
* Knowledge of data visualization and dashboard design best practices.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or machine learning technologies.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**Technical Skills** **Required**

* SQL
* Power BI
* Python
* UX Design
* Data Modeling
* Database Development
* Dashboard Development
* Application Development

**Preferred**

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React or Angular
* HTML/CSS
* REST APIs
* Azure
* Git / Source Control
* Power Automate
* AI and Generative AI Tools

Horizon Farm Credit is an expert in agriculture, with over 100 years of serving rural America. As a premier rural lender, we're constantly growing and seeking new members for our team. As part of the Horizon Farm Credit team, you have the opportunity to make a difference for agriculture and rural communities.


*What can we offer you?*

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages for full\-time employees including:


* Medical insurance with dental and vision care options

* Paid time off, holidays, and volunteer time to support work/life balance
* Tuition reimbursement and training opportunities

jobs.title: Program Analyst (BPM)
jobs.description:
The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking a program analyst in the Division of Budget and Procurement Management. The incumbent provides analytical, operational, and advisory support for the agency’s budget, procurement, and performance management functions. The position monitors and reports on program budgets across multiple fund types (including operating, enterprise, and capital), procurement activity, compliance with the District’s Small and Certified Business Enterprise Program, and key performance indicators and other organizational performance metrics. The incumbent coordinates budget, procurement, and performance\-related activities across agency divisions, and serves as a liaison with District partners, including the Office of the Chief Financial Officer, Office of Contracting and Procurement, Department of Small and Local Business Development, and the Mayor’s Office of Budget and Performance Management. Through analysis, coordination, and strategic support, the position facilitates compliance with applicable District and federal requirements, supports informed decision\-making, and promotes effective stewardship of agency resources and operational performance.


**Duties and Responsibilities**


Performs duties and special assignments independently, exercising complete judgment within the purview of established rules, regulations, and policies of the DC Department of Parks and Recreation. Provides critical analyses and evaluations of actual or potential effectiveness of current and/or projected program activities. Provides technical assistance in the design, development and implementation of improved program designs/operations. Reviews and analyzes planning and operations activities of major program areas administered by the department. Conducts management surveys, audits, projects, etc., and provides advisory services to operating or management officials. Based upon the assessments made, it identifies actual or potential problem areas, trends, and/or areas of significant concerns. Develops, recommends and implements policies for corrective actions, necessary to remedy deficiencies in program areas. Plans, develops and implements a system for obtaining and providing data required by the agency/department for long\-range planning and projections and that which is needed for evaluation of day\-to\-day operations.


Develops cost analyses of projects, performs cost\-benefit or economic evaluations of current or projected program(s). Forecasts and estimates requirements, and prepares programmatic reports, justifications, charts, graphs, statistical and narrative data, etc. Conducts continuous review and analysis of current or proposed programs and related administrative and financial activities; determines, through comprehensive assessment, effective utilization of resources at program level; identifies program strengths and deficiencies; and recommends changes or corrective action relative to program design, policies, procedures, and operations. Meets with agency officials and managers to provide advice, guidance and technical assistance to programs in the development of review indicators.

**Qualifications and Education**


Specialized experience is experience which is directly related to the position and has equipped the individual with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. To be creditable, the incumbent must possess at least one (1\) year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

**Licenses and Certifications**


None.

**Working Conditions/Environment**


The work is performed in an office setting involving everyday risks or discomforts, which require normal safety precautions typical of offices.

**Other Significant Facts**

**Tour of Duty:** Monday through Friday; 8:30 am – 5:30 pm. Shift work is required.

**Pay Plan, Series, and Grade:** CS\-0343\-13

**Duration of Appointment:** Career Service \- Regular

**Collective Bargaining Unit (Non\-Union):** This position is not covered under a Collective Bargaining Unit.

**Promotion Potential:**No known promotion potential

**Residency Preference:** When claiming residency preference, you are required, and must agree in writing, to maintain bona fide District residency for a period of seven (7\) consecutive years from the effective date of employment. You will be required to present documents (proofs) to show District residency and failure to maintain bona\-fide District residency for the seven\-year (7\-year) period will result in forfeiture of employment.

**Position Designation:** The position has been deemed **S****ecurity Sensitive**. Accordingly, the incumbent will be subject to pre\-employment checks (criminal background checks, consumer credit checks, traffic record checks, if applicable) as a condition of employment, and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks for the duration of your tenure.

**EEO Statement:**The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non\-merit factor.

Provides technical assistance in the design, development and implementation of improved program designs/operations for inspections, back\-office analysis, or escalated enforcement support. ---------------------------------

As Thomasville continues to grow organically and through acquisition, having the right operational foundation is critical. Our ability to enter new markets, build strong partnerships, integrate new teams, implement the right technology, and create scalable processes will help determine how successfully we grow.


The Operations Analyst will help Thomasville build and maintain the operational infrastructure necessary to support continued growth. This person will serve as a connector between people, processes, technology, and growth, helping ensure that as Thomasville gets bigger, we also get better.

* Help manage and maintain Thomasville’s operational readiness across current and future markets, including licenses, certifications, insurance requirements, registrations, and other operational requirements.

The candidate will report directly to our Program Manager (PM) and be responsible for the successful execution of the project and provide overall management support of Team Nakupuna staff ensuring alignment, growth, and exceptional client support.

  

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this position, but management may assign additional duties and responsibilities at any time. Specific duties include:

* Provides support for BUMED medical readiness facility portfolio to include building queries, reports, and analysis of data from Naval Facilities Systems Engineering Command’s (NAVFAC) and/or Marine Corps MAXIMO and eProjects systems to track the status of work and projects related to BUMED’s facility portfolio.
* Assist the PM with analysis and formatting of data supporting preparation of recurring and other deliverables.
* Support BUMED Headquarters and Regional staff with analysis and documents to answer facility\-related requests for information from BUMED leadership staff and other stakeholders as requested.
* Provide Subject Matter Expertise and analysis to support BUMED Facility Management\-related financial and planning activities such as annual enterprise Maintenance Action Plans, Program Objective Memorandum, and Special Projects Board.
* Provide support to BUMED Headquarters and Regional staff with expertise and analysis of key Real Property data repositories, documents, and systems such as the Facility Sustainment Model, Data Analysis and Integration Support (DAIS) Platform, Asset Reporting Management System (ARMS), Business Intelligence and Business Common System for DMLSS\-FM and LogiCole.
* Execute (as directed by the PM) DMLSS\-FM/LogiCole facility record updates, additions, and removals with approval from the BUMED Headquarters Real Property Officer.
* Provide support for BUMED commands with evaluation of Facility Management instructions and other guiding documents from DoD, Navy, DHA, and BUMED as requested.
* Responsible for the professionalism, timeliness, and quality of all contract performance requirements and deliverables.

 **Skills/Qualifications:** The ideal candidate for the Program Management Analyst position must possess strong leadership and organizational skills, with a proven track record in program support within a similar domain. They should have comprehensive knowledge of DMLSS\-FM, BUILDER, iNFADS, and other CMMS systems like NAVFAC MAXIMO and NAVFAC eProjects. Familiarity with performing analysis and using software for reporting (examples MS Lists, PowerBI, MS Excel). The candidate must be adept at coordinating complex tasks and activities across multiple regions and divisions, demonstrating exceptional communication skills to effectively liaise with government representatives, contractors, and various stakeholders. Expertise in developing and implementing contract management plans, quality control processes, and performance metrics is essential. The ability to provide effective training and support, both on\-site and remotely, is crucial. Additionally, the candidate should have strong analytical skills to evaluate business processes and implement efficient automated solutions. Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and maintaining comprehensive documentation is required, along with the flexibility to travel as necessary and manage multiple projects concurrently. A background in facilities management and familiarity with Navy Medicine operations will be highly advantageous.

**Education \& Experience:** This position requires a minimum of 5 years of professional experience. The ideal candidate will have an advanced degree or comparative years of professional experience in project management, or a similar field.

**Clearance Requirements:** Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a government\-issued CAC and possess a Secret security clearance.

**Physical Requirements:** The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job ***with or without*** ***a reasonable*** ***accommodation****:*

* Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
* Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
* Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.

  

The Nakupuna Companies use a market\-based compensation strategy to ensure that our employees are compensated within applicable market ranges commensurate with multiple factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability, organizational requirements, and position location. The projected compensation range for this position is $90,000\.00 to $95,000\.00 (annualized USD). The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Nakupuna Companies total compensation package for employees.

jobs.title: NewGen Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Program Director NewGen PA
\_\_

**Role overview:**


Leads the Tier 2 Architecture end\-to\-end Business Solution Design and coordinates development and implementation at the multinational, regional, or global function level, using ABB and/or third\-party resources. Leads project execution in accordance with company procedures, relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, project objectives, applicable quality standards, safety requirements, and cost and scheduling targets. Applies project management processes as applicable.

**Core responsibilities:**

**Project Leadership**

* Leads the team allocated to the project, defines the main guidelines, allocates project tasks, and motivates and monitors internal and/or external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones.
* Coaches, develops, and provides feedback to individuals allocated to managed projects. Provides input to the NewGen Resource Manager to support short\-term and longer\-term development planning for ABB employees.

**Instructions and guidelines:**

* Ensures projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with standard ABB internal directives and procedures, as described in the NewGen PMO Handbook. The project is governed under the ABB Gate Model.

**Budget, sales, and operations planning:**

* Keeps up to date and informed about any changes in strategy and is consulted regarding any activities or other projects that have, or might have, a major impact on the project.
* Develops and gains approval for a business case defining the value proposition of the project.

**Project execution and control:**

* Develops a project charter and a project plan (within MS Project) describing how the project will be executed, for communication to project team members and key stakeholders, approval, and as the basis for execution.
* Organizes, monitors, and controls activities to ensure the effective achievement of planned stage gates and efficient utilization of available resources.
* Monitors and controls project costs and financials. Identifies, contains, and reduces risks and ensures that all opportunities are captured and acted upon.
* Formalizes acceptance of the project and concludes all project activities. Prepares handover documentation and training.
* Manage consultancy partners and solution integrators
* Plans and tracks all project activities, establishes scheduling risks and opportunities, and delivers projects on time according to commitments.

**Stakeholder relations:**

* Serves as the key contact for project stakeholders and an escalation point for project issues.
* Communicates appropriate information to stakeholders in a timely and effective manner to achieve the desired understanding and support.
* Develops dedicated stakeholder management and change management plans and applies best practices in change management.

**People leadership and development:**

* Develops and manages team members through formal and informal mentoring and coaching.
* Ensures, in collaboration with the NewGen Resource Manager, appropriate qualification levels of the selected team members.
* Leads project team members to achieve project requirements, deliver agreed deliverables, and meet the committed project result.

**Document management:**

* In collaboration with the NewGen PMO, identifies and plans all document deliverables required by the contractual scope of work and incorporates this plan into the overall project plan/schedule.
* Tracks document progress and follows up on overdue comments from the NewGen PMO and Gate Assessors.

**Key requirements:**

* \+15 years of experience in leading the execution of internal strategic business projects at multinational, regional, or global function level, using internal and/or third\-party resources.
* Proven project management practice and experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to work in international teams.
* Certification: PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, Agile/Scrum certification (e.g., CSM, SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified according to 2YAD100055 IS Function Standard\_IS Project Manager Certification.


We are open to applications from all qualified candidates. However, from a collaboration perspective, we would preferably consider candidates who are already based in Europe.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.




Ready to make an impact?


Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: (Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.
  
  

**What sets us apart drives us ahead:** between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.
  
  

(Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80\-100%)
  
  

Zurich \| Working from home up to 40% possible \| Reference 8269
  
  

Would you like to shape the future of IAM across workforce identities, cloud services and AI agents? As a Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer, you are an IAM specialist who understands SailPoint IdentityIQ well enough to shape feasible concepts and challenge technical options, while owning stakeholder alignment, requirements and processes. You bring together business, governance, data and technology perspectives, communicate confidently with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and use data to support sound decisions. Working closely with IAM engineers, QA, operations, application owners, risk and audit, you turn emerging needs into sustainable processes and solutions. Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust guide how we work together and deliver value.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
Translate business, risk and regulatory needs into clear functional and non\-functional requirements, process models, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  
Shape and evolve IAM capabilities and governance models across workforce IAM, cloud services, non\-human identities including AI agents as well as policy\-based access control (PBAC), translating emerging needs into scalable processes and feasible solution concepts.
  
Develop solution designs for SailPoint IdentityIQ by assessing platform capabilities, defining workflows and data flows, and aligning concepts with IAM engineers and architects.
  
Analyze IAM data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps and automation opportunities, and present evidence\-based recommendations.
  
Act as the bridge between stakeholders and the distributed delivery team, supporting prioritisation, implementation, testing, rollout and adoption of sustainable IAM solutions.
  
What You Bring
  
Several years of experience as an IAM Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer or Consultant in IAM, with strong knowledge of IAM and IGA, access governance, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, role engineering, certifications, Segregation of Duties and relevant control requirements; experience with IAM aspects of cloud services or AI agents is an advantage.
  
Practical knowledge of SailPoint IIQ/ISC and a sound understanding of systems and application architecture, including how corporate systems work together.
  
Proven experience in requirements engineering, process modelling and the software development lifecycle, with sufficient technical literacy to assess feasibility, understand implementation approaches and constructively challenge technical proposals.
  
Strong analytical and data skills, including SQL and BI tools (Python is an advantage), with the ability to turn complex information into sound decisions and clear recommendations.
  
Confident communication and facilitation skills with technical and non\-technical stakeholders in English; German is an advantage, combined with customer focus, ownership and attention to detail.
  
  

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt at \+41583998670\.
  
  

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.
  
  

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

-----------


The Office of Information Technology is seeking an IT Specialist (INFOSEC) (Infrastructure Support Services (ISS) Program Manager). In this role, you will lead one of SEC's largest contracts providing customer support, endpoint management, and network \& infrastructure operations to drive strategy, delivery, security, and contractor oversight. PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk\-adjusted returns.


Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high\-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. * Serve as the primary relationship manager for contingent workforce suppliers and service providers.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager, IT PMO
jobs.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------



Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.


**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------



At Monster Energy, we move fast, push limits, and never settle for status quo — and our IT team is no different. We're looking for a Project Manager to join our IT PMO team and be the driving force behind technology projects that keep our business unstoppable. In this role, you'll lead IT projects from kickoff through completion, working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to keep initiatives on track, on budget, and aligned with company goals. You'll bring structure and clarity to complex projects, helping our teams move forward with focus and confidence. You will operate independently with minimal oversight, driving cross‑functional alignment across business and IT while influencing stakeholders and executives. If you enjoy solving problems, keeping people aligned, and helping technology run smoothly behind the scenes, join us and help fuel what's next.


**The Impact You'll Make:**
---------------------------



* Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, resource allocation, and risk management strategies.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams composed of IT staff, business stakeholders, and third\-party vendors through all phases of the project lifecycle — initiation, planning, design/requirements gathering, development (including integration coordination), QA testing, UAT, and closure.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business sponsors, technical teams, and executive leadership, ensuring alignment on objectives, priorities, and expectations.
* Track and report project status, milestones, budget performance, and key metrics using PMO standard tools and templates (e.g., dashboards, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, escalating appropriately and driving resolution in a timely manner
* Manage project scope and change control, evaluating change requests for impact on schedule, cost, and resources.
* Facilitate project meetings, including kickoffs, status updates, steering committee reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure adherence and adoption of PMO governance standards, methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid), and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate resource planning and allocation with functional managers to ensure project staffing needs are met.
* Manage vendor, SI, and contractor relationships, including scope adherence, deliverables, and contract compliance.
* Support budget forecasting, tracking, and reconciliation for assigned projects.
* Drive post\-implementation reviews and lessons\-learned sessions following a major release to support continuous improvement of PMO practices.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date project documentation in the PMO's project management system.
* Act as an ambassador for the PMO and project management functions.


**Who You Are:**
----------------



* Bachelor's degree in project management, business administration, information technology, or related field is required. Advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise\-grade IT projects with multi\-system dependencies. Preference within a formal PMO structure.
* Experience working within IT environments and familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and enterprise\-grade applications.
* Experience managing Salesforce platform projects, including implementations, enhancements, integrations, data flows, and ongoing application management.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal oversight.
* Proven ability to drive cross\-functional alignment across business and IT and influence stakeholders and executives without direct authority.
**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, hybrid approaches)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple, concurrent priorities
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams without direct authority and drive accountability across departments.
* Solid understanding of budgeting, financial tracking, and resource management principles.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk identification and mitigation.
* Strong vendor and SI partner management skills specific to Salesforce delivery
* Proficient with Microsoft Suite and project management tools. ClickUp and LucidChart or equivalent preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager, TA Ops
jobs.description:

Hourly rate: **$80/hour.** Benefits are available through Talent Table. **No C2C.**

**Key Deliverables / What You Will Do**

* Act as a trusted partner to Recruiting leadership and cross\-functional teams. Represent the recruiting function in projects, drive process optimization, influence decision\-making, and provide SME\-level guidance on recruiting operations, tools, and workflows.
* Design, manage, and optimize end\-to\-end recruitment workflows, leveraging process improvement methodologies to ensure efficiency, scalability, and alignment with organizational priorities. Drive continuous improvement of our recruiting technology stack by identifying gaps, evaluating processes, and creating impact through partnerships across Talent.
* Lead process improvement initiatives focused on scalability, automation, and simplification. Leverage insights to design streamlined workflows that reduce manual effort and improve quality and consistency across global teams.
* Serve as a liaison between TA, Product, and Engineering teams, employing project management frameworks to drive effective communication, prioritize tasks, and deliver complex cross\-functional initiatives on schedule.
* Leverage recruiting and operational data to identify trends, monitor performance, and develop actionable insights. Drive accountability around metric adoption, reporting integrity, and operational KPIs.
* Support the planning and execution of recruiting programs and technology implementations. Track milestones, ensure cross\-functional alignment, and surface risks and dependencies early.
* Oversee the development and governance of process documentation, training materials, and self\-service knowledge resources. Ensure accessibility, accuracy, and usability across teams.
* Partner closely with the TA Programs team to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable design requirements that drive TA initiatives.
* Partner with Talent Data \& Analytics, Security, and Legal to understand the implications of process or tooling decisions, including governance, compliance, and risk assessments.
* Oversee the testing and troubleshooting of new tools, systems, and processes to ensure successful implementation and adoption. Provide support and guidance throughout the implementation and training process.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives across Talent Acquisition, Talent, Finance, and business leadership, aligning stakeholders and clearing blockers before they escalate.
* Actively participate in post\-mortems to assess project outcomes, identify areas for improvement, and drive enhancements in project management processes and methodologies across global TA.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in Recruiting or HR Operations, with proven experience designing global workflows with a focus on cross\-functional excellence.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to inform strategic decision\-making, backlog prioritization, and solution development; familiar with Agile and Design Thinking methodologies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to solve complex challenges, utilizing critical thinking and analysis.
* Experience supporting technology or process implementations and managing complex stakeholder groups.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to extract insights from data, identify trends, develop recommendations, and create detailed action plans.
* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive), Slack, and Asana.
* Experience with Workday HCM and ATS systems is required.
* Eightfold experience is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Senior Technical Project Manager, Oracle Fusion is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and execution of technical workstreams supporting complex Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations and transformation initiatives. This role partners across IT, business functions, system integrators, and other stakeholders to drive successful delivery of integrations, data migration, testing, environments, security, technical architecture, cutover, and deployment activities. The position ensures technical deliverables are executed in alignment with business requirements, project timelines, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.


**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* Lead the planning and execution of technical workstreams for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations, including integrations, data migration, reporting, environments, security, testing, and deployment.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and delivery schedules while proactively identifying and addressing risks and issues.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities across internal IT teams, business stakeholders, system integrators, Oracle resources, and other external partners to ensure alignment and timely execution.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change controls for assigned technical workstreams.
* Lead technical testing activities, including System Integration Testing (SIT), end\-to\-end testing, performance testing, security testing, and support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring defects are effectively tracked and resolved.
* Coordinate Oracle Fusion environment management, release schedules, environment refreshes, code migrations, deployment activities, and production readiness.
* Develop and execute detailed technical cutover and go\-live plans, including readiness assessments, contingency planning, command center coordination, and issue escalation.
* Lead technical stabilization and hypercare activities following deployment, ensuring timely issue resolution and effective transition to ongoing operational and support teams.
* Facilitate technical governance, design reviews, project status meetings, and executive updates, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and required actions.
Apply strong project management practices, including RAID management, resource and budget planning, vendor management, dependency tracking, change management, and executive stakeholder communication.  
* 

**Minimum \& Preferred Qualifications and Experience:**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of progressive experience managing complex enterprise technology, ERP, or business transformation initiatives, including technical workstreams.
* Experience delivering at least two full\-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations, including integrations, data migration, testing, environments, security, cutover, and deployment.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross\-functional teams, system integrators, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Strong project management experience across scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and governance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP implementations within a global, regulated, or medical device environment.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or multi\-year ERP programs.
* PMP certification strongly preferred.
* Oracle Cloud, PMI\-ACP, Prosci, ITIL, or other relevant certifications preferred.
* Experience working across geographically dispersed teams and global business functions.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.


**Physical requirements/Work Environment**
------------------------------------------

This position primarily works in an office environment and requires frequent sitting, standing, and walking. Daily use of a computer and other digital devices is required. This role may require standing for extended periods when facilitating meetings or walking through facilities.


The physical demands of the position described herein are essential functions of the job and employees must be able to successfully perform these tasks for extended periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made for those individuals with real or perceived disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job described.

Epic Implementation Manager (Revenue Cycle)
jobs.description:
Overview:

Lead Enterprise Epic Implementations Across a National Health System


Prime Healthcare is an award\-winning health system headquartered in Ontario, California. Prime Healthcare operates 55 hospitals and has more than 360 outpatient locations in 15 states providing more than 3\.0million patient visits annually. It is one of the nation’s leading health systems with over 60,000 employees and physicians. Twenty\-one of the Prime Healthcare hospitals are members of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, a 501(c)(3\) not\-for\-profit public charity. Prime Healthcare is actively seeking new members to join our corporate team!


Are you an experienced Epic leader who has successfully driven full\-cycle implementations across complex hospital environments?


Prime Healthcare is seeking an experienced Epic Implementation Manager (Clinical) to lead enterprise\-wide deployments across our national health system. You will drive end\-to\-end clinical application implementations, partner closely with clinical and executive leadership, and ensure successful adoption across complex care environments. This is a high\-impact leadership role where your expertise shapes how care is delivered across dozens of hospitals.


What makes this role compelling:

* Lead enterprise\-wide clinical Epic implementations across 50\+ hospitals
* Influence provider workflows, patient care, and clinical outcomes

Own delivery across full lifecycle: design build* go\-live
* Lead and mentor large high\-performing analyst teams
* Partner directly with CMOs, Nursing Leadership, and Executives


Responsibilities:

Under the direction of the Epic Program Manager, the Epic Implementation Manager oversees Revenue Cycle applications, and is responsible for managing all aspects of future Epic implementations at Prime hospitals. The Implementation Manager will build relationships with hospital leadership to ensure corporate and local initiatives are incorporated into future implementations. After each go\-live, the Implementation Manager will oversee a comprehensive handoff to the Production Support team, ensuring a successful transition of support for the hospital. The Implementation Manager will supervise performance of all analysts on their team, which is comprised of the applications in their domain Revenue Cycle.


In this role, you will serve as the driving force behind enterprise Revenue Cycle Epic implementations, leading hospitals through each phase of the journey; from early planning and workflow design to go\-live and stabilization. As a leader, you’ll not only deliver successful implementations, but also mentor and develop your team while building strong, lasting partnerships across the organization.


On any given day, you’ll collaborate with clinical and executive leaders to align system design with real\-world care delivery, guide your team through build and testing milestones, and proactively navigate challenges to keep implementations on track. You’ll be at the center of the action during go\-live, ensuring teams are supported, workflows function as intended, and clinicians are set up for success.


What You’ll Do:

* Lead end\-to\-end Clinical Epic implementations
* Oversee design, build, testing, training, go\-live, and stabilization
* Partner with clinical stakeholders to align workflows and system design
* Ensure adoption of best\-practice clinical workflows
* Lead, coach, and manage clinical application analyst teams
* Drive milestone execution, risk mitigation, and delivery outcomes
* Oversee post\-go\-live transition to support teams
* Travel Requirement: This is a remote role that requires frequent travel (up to 50–75% annually) to hospital sites across the U.S., notably during key implementation phases.

* Minimum five (5\) years of experience working with electronic medical record required.
* Experience leading an Epic implementation required.

* Minimum four (4\) years of experience with an integrated healthcare information system preferred.
* Minimum four (4\) years of experience in project management preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare industry and hospital operations preferred.
* Experience leading large teams.
* Strong communication and organizational skills

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Los Angeles or Boston (hybrid)**



RedCircle is helping creators to turn their podcast into a business. As an Analyst, you'll play an integral part in our mission as you work with our finance, product, and growth teams to make sure we have the data, systems, and processes we need in order to grow the business. This role will work end\-to\-end across our data lifecycle, split between platform work (ensuring all of our data sources are connected to the team's tools, checked for quality, and modeled to support business uses) as well as distribution work (assisting the teams with building and maintaining dashboards, analyses, and other data products for ongoing and ad hoc needs).



If you love to dig deep into the numbers, have a customer\-first mindset, and are interested in podcasting / media / influencers, this is a great gig for you. Podcasting is \*exploding\*, and this is a chance to build a career at one of the top technology startups in the space.


### **Core Responsibilities**


* Act as a "full stack" data analyst, covering data analysis, visualization, data modeling in dbt, and ETL pipeline. You're not expected to be an expert in all these areas, but you should be interested in building your skills across this range and using AI to extend your skillset.
* Bring strong curiosity to what drives our business and the patterns reflected in our data, and use your analytical skillset to provide insights and tools to support company growth in direct collaboration with our CEO and CRO.
* Update and improve our data pipeline and data models to ensure complete and accurate information is available to teammates and connected tools.
* Collaborate with product, sales, leadership, and finance team members to conduct analyses that support business growth and product decision\-making. Examples of possible projects include: funnel evaluation, sales forecasting, revenue reporting, product analytics, and marketplace analysis.

### **A great candidate has/is…**


* 4\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role, with a deep skillset in one or more data analytics area (ETL pipelines, dbt data modeling, business intelligence) and exposure to the full data stack, including SQL, dbt, Python, and data warehouses
* 3\+ years of experience collaborating with growth or product teams to address core needs, communicate with nontechnical teammates, and equip them with relevant data tools and access
* A self\-starter who is excited about learning and testing new skills and tools, including AI, to improve availability and usefulness of data across the team
* Gets jazzed about owning projects from end\-to\-end. We're a small team, so you'll be responsible for a lot and you'll need to operate autonomously
* Can work hybrid in\-person at the RedCircle office in Los Angeles or Boston 3\-4 days per week


**Compensation**



RedCircle is committed to providing competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. Compensation for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the candidate's experience, and the scope of the role, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated base salary range for this role is $75\-130k. New hire offers typically fall in the first half of the range. The higher end of the range may be considered for candidates who significantly exceed the minimum experience requirements and bring advanced skills and specialized expertise.


**About RedCircle**



RedCircle is everything a podcaster needs to run their podcast as a business. With tools for analytics, growth, payments, and advertising revenue, podcast creators use RedCircle as their command center for their podcast. RedCircle also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind podcast advertising platform, which helps brands scale ad campaigns across its thousands of podcasts in just a few clicks. As consumers, creators, and brands all flock to the podcasting medium, RedCircle is providing the picks and shovels to help all 3 groups transact.



With over 100 million monthly downloads, RedCircle is growing its community of podcasters and helping deliver millions in revenue for its creators. The company is growing quickly, is backed by some of Silicon Valley's top VCs, and is growing its team to keep up. If you want to help podcasters turn their art into income, this is the place for you.



RedCircle is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

A Reporting Data Analyst, you will drive the reporting and analytics behind our sales and operations planning (S\&OP) process for our portfolio of Adventure Sports brands, delivering insights across demand, supply, and inventory — leveraging AI tools embedded throughout how we analyze data and report on it.


You will partner with demand and supply planning, operations, finance, and commercial teams to build dashboards and recurring S\&OP deliverables, consolidating large data sets from disparate, fragmented sources that require cleansing and reconciliation into clear narratives on risks, opportunities, and trends. AI fluency is a core requirement: you will be expected to actively use and continuously expand your use of AI tools across the reporting workflow.


This position reports to the Director of S\&OP and is based out of our Irvine, CA office.


As the **S\&OP Data** **Analyst,** you will have an opportunity to:


**S\&OP Reporting \& Cadence**

* Support the monthly and weekly S\&OP reporting cycle across demand, supply, inventory, and executive review meetings.
* Build, maintain, and distribute recurring reports and dashboards that summarize plan vs. actual performance, forecast accuracy, and key supply chain KPIs.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready PowerPoint summaries and pre\-reads that highlight trends, risks, and recommended actions.
* Maintain reporting calendars, trackers, and QA checklists to ensure on\-time, accurate deliverables.
* Use AI tools to draft executive narratives, summarize variances, and accelerate the production of recurring S\&OP deliverables.

* Enthusiasm for AI and experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar tools to enhance reporting and analytics productivity, with a willingness to keep expanding that skill set.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Alma**



At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well\-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.



Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.



As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.



With 380\+ Almakers and €100M\+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!


### **About the team**



Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.



Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.



This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.



You will report to Basil Lizotte, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops \& Risk, Product and Tech.


### **About the job**



As Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.



You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.


#### **Build reliable data foundations for Revenue**


* Build and evolve business\-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.
* Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end\-to\-end data pipelines.

#### **Turn business questions into strategic insights**


* Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.
* Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.

#### **Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth**


* Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.
* Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.

#### **Drive data excellence across Revenue**


* Promote data\-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.
* Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.

### **You will work with**



SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce


### **About you**


#### **To succeed in this job**


* You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue\-related information, including Salesforce data.
* You have experience building business\-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.
* You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.
* You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast\-growing technology or fintech environment.

#### **And it will be nice if you also**


* You have experience with Looker and LookML.
* You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.
* You have worked with tracking tools such as Rudderstack or Segment, as well as experimentation methodologies such as A/B testing, significance testing and causal analysis.
* You are curious about AI\-assisted tools and are interested in using tools such as Claude Code in your daily workflow.


Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.


### **Your Alma experience**


#### **The culture**



At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast\-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.



You will have access to our Learning \& Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.



We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.


#### **The role itself**



If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:


* Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
* Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
* Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

### **Compensation \& benefits**


* **Competitive salary** based on 12 months
* **Profit\-sharing and employee savings plan**
* **Health insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma, including family package
* **Disability insurance**: **100%** covered by Alma
* **Sport**: partnerships with **Gymlib** and **ClassPas

Le département Forensic \& Integrity Services accompagnent nos clients pour répondre à leurs enjeux d’intégrité, de compliance et d’éthique.
