* La conception, l’évaluation et l’amélioration de programmes de compliance afin de minimiser leur risque de corruption, de fraude et, plus largement, de non\-compliance.
* Les investigations en cas de fraude suspectée ou avérée (corruption, détournement d’actifs, fraude aux états financiers, blanchiment d’argent, infractions à des règlements spécifiques), ou à la demande des autorités de régulation.


Pour ce faire, nous nous appuyons sur une triple expertise :

* Gestion des risques : compliance, contrôle interne, audit interne, audit financier
* Innovation digitale : financial data analytics, data science, digital forensic
* Connaissance de la réglementation (Sapin 2, FCPA, sanctions, etc.), au service de dispositifs opérationnels




**Vos principales responsabilités :**

Intégré(e) dans notre équipe IT Forensic, vous travaillerez sur des cas concrets d’analyse de données lors d’investigation de fraude ou de conformité légale (SAPIN2, GDPR, Secret des affaires etc…)

* Analyser des volumes de données importants en travaillant sur les opérations et les résultats financiers de nos clients (Groupes internationaux, CAC 40, …).
* Maîtriser les différentes technologies et architectures utilisées par nos clients (ERP, bases de données, etc..) et vous adaptez, si besoin est, les moyens d’analyse des données.
* Investiguer sur des suspicions de fraudes en développant des outils agiles : collecte de données, traitement de données et data visualisation.
* Intervenir dans un contexte international lors de missions avec vos collègues d’autres pays et vous êtes parfois en relation directe avec nos clients étrangers.

* Vous maîtrisez divers des langages de programmation par ex : SQL, Java, PYTHON, etc…
* Vous avez une expérience ou une appétence dans des logiciels de Dataviz tels que Tableau Software, PowerBI ou Qlik.
* Vous avez des connaissances avancées en mathématiques/statistiques.
* Vous connaissez les problématiques inhérentes aux systèmes informatiques et vous avez une appétence pour les problématiques financières et un gout pour l’investigation.




**Ce que nous recherchons:**

* Vous êtes étudiante ou étudiant au sein d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une universitéavec une majeure en système d’information, en Dataviz ou en Datascience
* Vous recherchez un stage de 4 à 6 mois, dans le cadre d’une césure ou d’une fin d’études.
* Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de dynamisme et souhaitez vous investir dans une offre de services en fort développement
* Votre rigueur et votre autonomie vous permettent d’intervenir pour gérer des problématiques métiers et informatiques dans des situations variées et complexes de différents secteurs d’activités.




**Ce que nous vous offrons :**

* Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
* L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale.
* Une carte titre\-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75%.

**Etes\-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.**


Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 étapes ; des tests à réaliser en ligne, ainsi qu’une ou deux rencontres avec nos managers.


Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions.

jobs.title: STAGE DATA ANALYST MARKETING F/H
jobs.description:
*En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises \& organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums.*
*L'entreprise* ***EDF*** *recherche actuellement des profils :*  

Le groupe EDF est l'un des premiers électriciens mondiaux, à la pointe de l'innovation technologique. Le respect de la personne et celui de l'environnement, l'intégrité, la solidarité sont au cœur de nos actions. Face à l’urgence climatique, notre rôle est d’inventer un modèle énergétique qui respecte notre planète.


Nous voulons construire un monde où il sera possible de produire une électricité neutre en CO2, grâce au nucléaire et aux énergies renouvelables, conciliant préservation de la planète, bien\-être et développement, grâce à l’électricité et à des solutions et services innovants.


\\n\\n
Au sein de la Direction Marketing Professionnalisation \& Opérations (DMPO) de la DCR (Direction Commerciale Régionale) Île\-de\-France, vous intégrerez le Pôle Marketing Clients.


Le portefeuille client de la Direction Commerciale Régionale est très riche car composé de grands clients sur différents segments avec des enjeux importants de placement de fournitures, de services et d'électrification des usages.


Ce poste combine exécution, coordination, analyse et vision stratégique à l’échelle régionale et nationale. Ce stage vous permettra d’avoir un impact direct sur la performance commerciale via l’optimisation des campagnes marketing et la valorisation des données clients.


Sujet de stage :


Data \& Marketing BtoB: conquête et veille commerciale stratégique dans le secteur de l’énergie BtoB.


Les missions seront adaptées progressivement en fonction de votre montée en compétence.


Suivre et améliorer la rentabilité des campagnes marketing, en lien avec les équipes commerciales (Direction des Ventes) et de services (Direction Territoires et Services) :


a) Assurer un suivi régulier des performances des campagnes (emails /SMS, courriers, appels sortants)


b) Identifier les points d’optimisation et proposer des actions correctrices


c) Préparer les flash info Campagne Marketing et présentation PPT pour les réunions de suivi (MY Actu Vente, Copil Fourniture, point suivi campagne etc)


Nettoyer, structurer et fiabiliser les données clients issues de différentes sources (CRM, DataHub, fichiers externes)


Construire des ciblages clients et prospects à partir des données traitées


Participer activement au réseau national une fois par mois, pour partager les bonnes pratiques, mutualiser les actions marketing et contribuer à des projets communs à l’échelle nationale.


Mettre en œuvre des campagnes emailing et courrier ciblées destinées à générer des leads qualifiés, en assurer le suivi et transmettre les leads aux équipes commerciales.


Utiliser, mettre à jour et faire évoluer les différents tableaux de bord POWER BI et CRM de suivi de campagne marketing et de connaissance clients.




Pourquoi nous rejoindre


Un stage à forte exposition (COPIL, My Actu Vente…)


Une interaction directe avec les équipes commerciales et le management

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.



We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.



You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries.

### **About the Role**



As the Senior Global Operations Manager of Fulfillment \& Outbound Logistics, you will own Verkada's global 3PL network and oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across multiple regions. You'll be responsible for optimizing supply chain performance, managing strategic logistics partners, driving cost savings, and ensuring world\-class service levels. We're looking for an experienced operations leader who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges, and is passionate about building scalable global logistics processes.


### **What You'll Do**


* Own and manage strategic partnerships with global 3PL providers, including vendor selection, contract negotiations, performance management, and quarterly business reviews.
* Oversee inbound, warehouse, and outbound logistics operations across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels across the supply chain.
* Develop and monitor KPIs including freight costs, inventory performance, order accuracy, fill rates, and on\-time delivery.
* Manage inventory deployment strategies, distribution network optimization, and reverse logistics (RMA/refurbishment) programs.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, and external logistics providers to resolve operational issues and improve execution.
* Establish and maintain supply chain SOPs while driving adoption of best practices across internal teams and 3PL partners.
* Lead implementation and optimization of supply chain systems, including WMS, TMS, and ERP integrations.
* Present operational performance, trends, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

### **What You Bring**


* 8\+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or operations management, including 5\+ years managing 3PL partnerships.
* Experience overseeing global logistics operations across multiple regions and international supply chains.
* Strong background in warehouse, transportation, fulfillment, and distribution network management.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP platforms, and advanced Excel for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven success driving cost reduction initiatives and improving operational efficiency through process optimization.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and holding logistics providers accountable to SLAs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate data into operational improvements.
* Excellent communication and project management skills with experience leading cross\-functional initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. APICS CSCP, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certifications are a plus.

### **Employee Benefits**



Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:


* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well\-being needs \- Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

* Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

* You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

**Department Overview**  

Responsible for the delivery of information security services including intelligence research, threat assessment, security event monitoring/analysis, vulnerability management and security tool administration in support of PG\&E’s enterprise security goals and objectives. Cyber Threat Specialists use a variety of commercial and custom tools and processes to provide the information security services mentioned above. Cyber Threat Specialists are experts in the operation of these tools and have the ability to design improvised solutions on the fly when dealing with active threats. Cyber Threat Specialists produce metrics and statistics that feed complimentary processes in PG\&E such as risk assessment, patching, anti\-virus, firewall management, etc. Cyber Threat Specialists are very technically skilled and have the ability to work successfully with other technical teams within PG\&E’s IT department and beyond.

The Monitoring \& Response Team (also known as M\&R) is the 24x7 security operations team that is essentially PG\&E’s first line of defense that is continuously preventing, detecting, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity events to improve the organization’s security posture. The Monitoring \& Response Team is built with the foundation of a standard SOC but operates differently by utilizing Threat Intelligence in our daily investigations of security events. The Monitoring \& Response Team also operates in a proactive/reactive manner to maintain the highest level of efficacy in their tasks.

- Monitors daily cybersecurity activity in shifts through looking at tools to determine if activity is malignant or benign and then engage others as required
  

- Provides analysis on malware and escalates as appropriate to incident response Teams
  

- Does baseline threat hunting based on intelligence for utility peers and other intelligence sources
  

- Provides hunting/analysis on phishing cases and reports of potential compromise/breach

- Assists in performing basic research internally and externally

- Develops a strategy to implement work in department
  

  

**Qualifications**  

Minimum:  

- High School or GED\-General Educational Development\-GED Diploma
  

  

**Desired:**  

- Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or job\-related discipline or equivalent experience
  

- IT\-Information Technology Security certification

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Infrastructure Capacity Planning
jobs.description:
Technical Program Management \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization builds and operates the infrastructure required to train and serve frontier AI models. The Capacity Planning team connects rapidly changing research and product demand with the compute, networking, storage, power, data center, hardware, and operational resources required to make that demand executable.


**About the Role**


We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to build and lead capacity planning across OpenAI's large\-scale AI infrastructure. You will translate uncertain workload demand into clear infrastructure requirements, allocation decisions, supply commitments, activation priorities, and long\-range capacity strategies.


This role sits at the intersection of research, engineering, infrastructure, finance, sourcing, deployment, and operations. You will create the planning models, operating cadences, governance mechanisms, and source\-of\-truth systems that allow teams to understand what capacity is required, what is available, what is at risk, and what decisions must be made.


This is not a finance\-only forecasting or reporting role. Success requires technical fluency across the infrastructure stack, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to move consequential decisions forward when requirements, timelines, and supply conditions change quickly.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own capacity\-planning processes across near\-term workload allocation, quarterly execution, and longer\-range infrastructure horizons.
* Translate research, training, inference, and product demand into compute, accelerator, cluster, networking, storage, rack, power, and site requirements.
* Develop scenarios that make assumptions, confidence levels, constraints, sensitivities, and decision points explicit.
* Reconcile requested demand against contracted, delivered, installed, activated, and workload\-usable capacity.
* Partner with research and engineering teams to understand workload priorities, technical dependencies, utilization patterns, and changing requirements.
* Partner with sourcing, finance, hardware, deployment, and operations teams to align supply commitments, activation schedules, costs, and delivery risks.
* Support allocation and prioritization decisions when infrastructure is constrained or delivery plans change.
* Track infrastructure lead times, critical dependencies, utilization, headroom, forecast accuracy, activation readiness, and capacity risk.
* Build dashboards, analytical tools, executive updates, and operating cadences that create a credible source of truth.
* Drive mitigation plans for site delays, hardware shortages, network or storage constraints, workload changes, and other capacity risks.
* Continuously improve planning models, governance, data quality, and accountability as OpenAI's infrastructure scales.

**Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in technical program management, infrastructure capacity planning, cloud infrastructure, supply planning, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated ownership of capacity planning for large\-scale distributed systemss, AI or ML workloads, or hyperscale infrastructure.
* Ability to translate ambiguous demand into structured assumptions, scenarios, technical resource requirements, and executable plans.
* Technical fluency across compute, networking, storage, data center infrastructure, utilization, reliability, and deployment dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience developing planning models, operational metrics, dashboards, or data\-driven decision systems.
* Experience leading decisions across engineering, finance, sourcing, deployment, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain uncertainty, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly.

**Preferred Skills**


* Experience planning GPU, accelerator, or AI infrastructure capacity for training or inference workloads.
* Experience with cluster allocation, cloud capacity, hardware supply, infrastructure procurement, site readiness, or production activation.
* Familiarity with forecasting methods, scenario planning, optimization, cost attribution, capacity economics, and utilization management.
* Experience building planning tools or source\-of\-truth systems using SQLs, or similar technologies.
* Track record of improving utilization, reducing infrastructure cost or risk, and enabling critical workloads during periods of constrained supply.

**Location**


San Francisco, California. This role requires regular in\-person collaboration with infrastructure, research, and operational partners.


**About OpenAI**


OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high\-risk product decisions, often in fast\-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross\-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision\-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross\-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment, strategic foresight, and the ability to operate across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual\-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large\-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject\-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  

  

  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy\-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high\-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision\-making through risk\-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow\-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI\-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high\-pressure, high\-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross\-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs

* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance\-related product issues
* Experience with consumer\-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products

Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross\-functional projects and/or teams
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product\-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Track record for being detail\-oriented with a demonstrated ability to self\-motivate and follow\-through on projects

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1\) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2\) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3\) to protect the whole home.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, detail\-oriented project manager who thrives in complex, ambiguous federal healthcare environments and can translate program performance data into clear, compelling narratives for senior leadership and legislative audiences, especially with regard to the development of data\-driven and value\-based health care solutions that transform and improve Veteran care while reducing cost and administrative burden.
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

Lead end\-to\-end project management of VA healthcare pilot and innovation efforts, including scope definition, work planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder coordination across program lifecycle phases.
  
  

Develop, maintain, and deliver high\-quality performance reports and program dashboards tailored for Senior Executive Service (SES) review, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with VA strategic priorities.
  
  

Support the preparation of Congressional reporting packages, briefing materials, and responses to data calls, ensuring compliance with federal reporting standards and legislative requirements.
  
  

Facilitate cross\-functional working groups and pilot site coordination meetings, capturing action items, decisions, and risks while driving accountability among internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

Monitor and evaluate pilot program performance metrics against defined success criteria, identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities for course correction or scale\-up recommendations.

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

Minimum 4 years of project management experience, with demonstrated experience managing healthcare pilot programs, innovation initiatives, or similarly complex multi\-stakeholder engagements.
  
  

Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Public Health, Health Administration, Business Administration, Public Policy, or a related field required.
  
  

Prior experience supporting federal agency clients, VA program offices, or federal healthcare environments strongly preferred; familiarity with VA organizational structure and mission is highly desirable.
  
  

Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation; active clearance or prior federal suitability determination is a plus.
  
  

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship; this position supports a federal government contract and is subject to applicable federal employment eligibility requirements.
  
  

Demonstrated experience developing performance reports, briefing materials, or data packages for senior government leaders (SES\-level or equivalent) and/or Congressional stakeholders.
  
  

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strongly preferred. \| \- Experience with VA or federal health innovation offices (e.g., VHA Innovation Ecosystem, CMMI, CMTO, or equivalent) is a significant plus. \| \- Familiarity with federal performance management frameworks such as GPRAMA, OMB reporting requirements, or VA MISSION Act implementation. \| \- Experience using VA\-approved collaboration and project tracking tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Teams, or equivalent federal\-compliant platforms). \| \- Prior experience coordinating Congressional data calls, GAO engagements, or IG responses in a federal healthcare contracting context.

**About** MelodyArc


MelodyArc is building the orchestration layer for enterprise service work — where rules, people, and AI collaborate to get complex operations done reliably at scale. Our orchestration core (the Point Engine) enables teams to configure agentic AI Operators that execute work end\-to\-end while leveraging existing business logic and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.


**Role Overview**


A MelodyArc Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) runs delivery for a core area of the platform. You build the plan, drive technical design to closure with engineering, clear blockers, and hold the launch gate. Product owns strategy, roadmap, and requirements; you own the plan that delivers them.


The work is technical. You read the design doc, find the dependency nobody raised, trace the integration that keeps failing, and query the telemetry yourself. You operate across engineering, Deployment Strategists, and customer teams, inside live enterprise deployments where reliability, security, and adoption are the bar.


**The Impact You Will Have**


* **Program plan and critical path:** Own the delivery plan for a core product area. Map dependencies across engineering, deployment, and customer teams. Sequence milestones, track the critical path, and hold teams to dates.


* **Technical design:** Drive the technical design review to closure with engineering. Reason about APIs, webhooks, event flows, data contracts, permissions, reliability, and observability.


* **Unblocking:** Run down integration failures, environment issues, data access, third\-party dependencies, and cross\-team conflicts. Escalate with a recommendation, not a status.


* **Release readiness:** Define readiness criteria and launch gates with Product and engineering. Own rollout plans, staged deployment, rollback paths, and go/no\-go.


* **Evaluation and defect flow:** Stand up the feedback loop for agentic workflows. Route task outcomes, transcripts, exceptions, and user feedback into triage, and drive defects to closure against the quality bar Product sets.


* **Instrumented execution:** Use SQL and telemetry to track delivery health, adoption, and regression. Report from data.


* **Communication:** Own status to leadership and customers. Surface risk early with options and a recommendation.


* **Scale impact:** Contribute reusable delivery patterns, templates, and operating practices, and channel field feedback to Product.


**Basic Qualifications**


* 8\+ years in technical program management, delivery leadership, or software engineering, including ownership of enterprise or platform releases.


* A substantial hands\-on technical foundation. You can independently write and read SQL, work with JSON and APIs, understand webhooks and event\-driven integrations, inspect code when needed, and build or modify lightweight prototypes. Experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable tooling is strongly relevant.


* Track record driving programs from design review through production in environments where reliability, data quality, security, and latency matter.


* Experience delivering AI or ML systems into production. You treat evaluation, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop design as delivery scope.


* Command of dependency management, risk tracking, and escalation.


* Comfort working directly with customer technical teams and business operators. You can build trust with senior leaders while also getting specific enough with practitioners to understand what is really happening.


* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You bring structure to ambiguity, make technical choices legible to non\-technical stakeholders, and create alignment without waiting for every detail to be handed to you.


* A high\-ownership, low\-ego working style. You enjoy moving between planning and detailed execution, and you do not let an important deliverable stall because it sits outside a narrow job description.


* Based in the United States with professional working proficiency in English.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with agentic AI products, LLM evaluation, or production systems combining automation with human review.


* Experience delivering on configurable, multi\-tenant platforms or complex enterprise integrations.


* Domain experience in customer service operations, contact\-center technology, or other high\-volume business\-process operations.


* Experience supporting customer deployments, technical integrations, or forward\-deployed work.

Remote (United States). Some travel to customer sites may be required.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst II
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**


At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

**Position Summary**


We are seeking a Data Analyst II to own recurring reporting and ad hoc analysis for an assigned manufacturer program or internal domain, becoming the person who knows that program's enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and data sources deeply. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data \& Analyticsdepartment and reports to the Manager, Analytics \& Reporting, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards.


Depth in one program or domain beats a thin layer across many, especially in the first year. This role has no direct reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own one manufacturer program or internal domain deeply: its enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and where its data comes from and lives.
* Own recurring reporting that goes out on a schedule: weekly and monthly program reporting plus support for daily feeds, reviewing numbers before they leave and raising unexplained changes rather than shipping them.
* Answer questions with a deadline attached by tracing them through claim adjudication, prior authorization status, prescription state changes, and fulfillment records, returning an answer plus your confidence in it.
* Write down metric definitions when you settle a disagreement for your program, keep reporting consistent with them, and document them where the next person will find them.
* Build dashboards in Looker, our primary BI platform (Metabase also in use, migrating off Domo), including client\-facing Looker work that is still being stood up, and raise a dbt model request when logic belongs in the warehouse rather than in a dashboard tile.
* Handle PHI carefully as a daily practice: know what your access covers, use the minimum you need, and ask before moving patient\-level data anywhere new.

**Qualifications**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree preferred; not required. We evaluate demonstrated capability rather than credentials.
* **Licensure/Certification**: Not applicable.
* **Experience**: Typically 2 to 4 years of experience in data analysis. This band is guidance rather than a gate.
* **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**:
	+ Can take a vague question, sharpen it into something answerable, and come back with the answer and its caveats without needing to be checked on daily.
	+ Validates work: counts rows, compares against a second source, and asks why a total does not tie before anyone else has to ask.
	+ Writes and speaks plainly about what you found, so someone in an account or operations role can read your summary and act on it.
	+ Comfortable being told a number is wrong: finds out why and says so rather than quietly patching it, and is curious about how the healthcare and pharmacy operation actually works.
	+ A couple of years of analysis work where SQL was the main tool: you can write more than a simple join, including window functions and careful aggregation, and you take the time to figure out grain before writing anything.
	+ Demonstrated application of the above Qualification
	+ Nice to have: pharmacy, claims, or payer data experience (prior authorizations, adjudication, benefit verification, NDCs, dispensing workflows); dbt experience contributing transformation logic rather than only reading from it; Looker or LookML exposure; Snowflake (we are mid\-migration from PostgreSQL); Python for analysis that does not fit in SQL; or experience producing work that went to an external client.

**Work Environment**

* **Location**: Columbus, OH or Remote (US).
* **Schedule**: Full\-time; standard business hours.
* May require flexibility around reporting deadlines tied to weekly, monthly, and daily program feeds.
* Regular collaboration with account and operations teams and manufacturer program contacts, plus time on the distribution center floor and with the call center to understand the operation firsthand.

**Key Essential Functions**

* Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods
* Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with account and operations stakeholders
* Must be able to handle and access data in compliance with HIPAA and PHI handling requirements
* Must be able to periodically visit the distribution center and call center to observe operations firsthand

**Employment Classification**

**Status:** Full\-time
  

**FLSA:** Exempt

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**


Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.


We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply!

**Disclaimer**


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

new_jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst (Temporary)
new_jobs.description:
Simpson Strong\-Tie is a leader in engineered structural connectors, software, and solutions for the building industry. We maintain a reputation as a trusted manufacturer, partner, and corporate citizen committed to our customers and employees.


Our founder, Barc Simpson established 9 Principles of Business we live out as company values and have made Simpson Strong\-Tie an inspiring place to work since 1956\. Our team of talented people are dedicated to our shared mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.


Learn about our company culture directly from our team.

**YOU**
=======


This temporary 4–6\-month position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in advancing Talent Acquisition operations. As the Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst, you will serve as a strategic operations, analytics, and enablement partner for the Talent Acquisition team. You will translate recruiting data into clear insights, lead or support TA technology implementations, standardize processes and resources, and create scalable tools that improve hiring consistency, speed, quality, and candidate experience. This role partners closely with HR partners, hiring managers, HR operations, communications, and external vendors to turn strategy into practical execution.


This position requires a proactive, detail\-oriented problem solver who can manage complex projects, communicate clearly across audiences, troubleshoot systems and process gaps, and use data to influence continuous improvement across the recruiting lifecycle.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
========================

**Talent Acquisition Analytics, Reporting and Insights (30%)**


Generate, analyze and communicate TA metrics that help leadership, recruiters, HR partners and business stakeholders understand recruiting performance, hiring trends and opportunities for improvement.

* Maintain and improve recurring and ad hoc reporting on requisition volume, time\-to\-fill/time\-to\-offer, offer approvals, source performance, recruiter workload, platform usage, referral and internal applicant activity, quality\-of\-hire inputs and early turnover trends.
* Prepare quarterly TA performance reviews, executive summaries, dashboards, and slide\-ready insights that highlight progress, risks, root causes and recommended actions.
* Maintain and enhance recruiter scorecards, operational tracking tools and KPI frameworks to support accountability, prioritization and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Analyze applicant funnel health, sourcing channel performance and location\-specific challenges to inform proactive sourcing, advertising and candidate flow strategies.

**TA Technology, Systems and Process Optimization (30%)**


Lead and support implementation, adoption and continuous improvement of TA systems and workflows, with a focus on scalable, compliant and user\-friendly recruiting operations.

* Serve as a key TA project partner for recruiting technology initiatives, including Paradox/Ty interview scheduling and referrals, SHL assessment integration, HiredScore implementation, Workday recruiting enhancements and related platform changes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, system troubleshooting, hypercare support, issue logs, enhancement requests, access questions and cross\-functional follow\-up with HR systems, IT and vendors.
* Partner with TA and business stakeholders to standardize intake forms, job description/job posting content, required vs. preferred skills mapping, stage definitions, candidate communications and disposition templates.
* Evaluate system adoption and process gaps, recommend improvements, and develop scalable solutions that reduce manual work, improve consistency and strengthen candidate and hiring manager experience.

**Program, Project and Change Management (25%)**


Plan, coordinate and execute TA programs and strategic initiatives from concept through rollout, ensuring stakeholders are aligned, resources are ready, and adoption is supported.

* Update and maintain the Talent Acquisition Playbook, Hiring Manager Portal resources, job aids, FAQs, templates, process documentation and operating standards for recruiters, HR partners and hiring managers.
* Develop and deliver training and change\-management materials for new TA processes and tools, including live sessions, My Workbench content, recordings, guides, communication drafts and follow\-up resources.
* Support structured interviewing, hiring events, dedicated interview pool pilots, first\-year turnover improvement work, candidate experience initiatives and quality\-of\-hire measurement efforts.
* Manage project plans, agendas, meeting cadences, action items and stakeholder updates to keep cross\-functional work moving and aligned to TA priorities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Recruiting Operations Partnership (15%)**


Act as a central coordination point across TA, HR, business leaders and external partners to strengthen recruiting operations, vendor effectiveness and stakeholder experience.

* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs and hiring managers on recruiting process improvements, branch/location hiring challenges, priority requisitions and manager communication needs.
* Manage or support vendor relationships and utilization for platforms and partners such as Paradox, Workday, SHL, HiredScore, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and related recruiting tools.
* Support recruiter and hiring manager enablement through clear communication, meeting facilitation, resource sharing, troubleshooting and escalation of system or process issues.
* Contribute to employer brand, employee referral, social media spotlight, community outreach and candidate communication initiatives that improve attraction and engagement.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
===========================

Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. is a global leader in protective services, delivering specialized guarding, advanced technology solutions, and comprehensive risk management to clients across diverse industries. Our mission is clear: *to help make your world a safer place*. With a strong legacy of trust, innovation, and global expertise, we design and deliver tailored security programs that combine cutting\-edge technology with exceptional service.

 **Position: Senior Regional Program Manager – Security**  

**Location: Onsite at client facility, Manhattan, NY**

  

The Senior Regional Program Manager (SRPM) is the client’s primary Security Advisor and strategic partner, responsible for the overall security program across the assigned regional portfolio. This role owns the account strategy end\-to\-end, leading the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive security program that aligns Securitas and client objectives.

  

The SRPM drives program performance, profitability, and consistency across all locations, ensuring a scalable and sustainable security posture. A core focus is proactive risk management, identifying issues early, implementing forward\-looking recommendations, and preventing recurrence through robust processes, standards, and controls.

**Compensation and Benefits**


Securitas offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package. Based on experience, the starting salary range for this role is **$150,000–$156,000**, plus a full benefits program that includes:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 10 accrued vacation days, 4 floating holidays, and 6 sick days
* Monthly parking provided
* Bonus eligible

	+ Serve as the key point of contact and trusted Security Advisor for the client.
	+ Drive continuous improvement and evolution of the regional security program, ensuring alignment with client risk appetite and business priorities.

	+ Ensure appropriate staffing levels in collaboration with area management.

* **Governance, Transitions \& Contract Compliance**
	+ Conduct regular account reviews with client and Securitas leadership.

* **Strategic Budgeting \& Investment Planning**

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Credit & Lending
new_jobs.description:
Mercury is building Mercury Bank, N.A., a proposed nationally chartered bank focused on serving ambitious businesses. Credit and lending are central to that mission, and as we migrate our charge card and term loan products to the Bank's own balance sheet and build the next generation of lending infrastructure, we need someone who can hold the full program together.



The Senior Technical Program Manager for Credit and Lending will own end\-to\-end delivery of the technology programs that power Mercury's charge card, term loan, and adjacent credit products. You will be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations: setting strategy for how these programs run, surfacing tradeoffs that unblock leaders, sequencing the critical path, and ensuring that what ships is audit\-ready from day one.



We are looking for someone who has operated at this level before, in a regulated environment, at scale, with real accountability for outcomes.


* *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC\-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

* Own the integrated program plan across all active credit and lending workstreams, covering milestones, dependencies, and critical paths across Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations.

#### **Communication and influence**


* Produce concise, predictable updates calibrated to the audience.
* Synthesize complex cross\-functional information into recommendations that help executives decide and move.
* Produce documentation of program objectives, architecture decisions, and operational impacts that onboards new team members without requiring a meeting to explain it.
* Function as a trusted thought partner to engineering leads, product managers, and senior leadership.

#### **Execution and improvement**


* Identify inefficiencies and eliminate them through automation, AI tooling, or process redesign.
* Lead technical retrospectives and post\-mortems, ensuring learnings are systematized rather than forgotten.

### **What we're looking for:**


#### **Experience**


* 10\+ years of program management or technical program management in a high\-growth or regulated environment.
* Direct experience in financial services, fintech, or credit infrastructure. Compliance, audit, reporting and risk management obligations are familiar territory.

#### **How you work**


* Product\-first. You evaluate everything through: what is the user problem, what is the fastest path to learning, what actually moves the needle.
* AI\-native. You use AI tools to do your actual work. You have built workflows or tooling that changed how your team operates. When you see a repetitive process, you automate it.

### **What you bring:**


* Technical fluency. You can understand and challenge engineering decisions, identify technical risks early, and translate complexity for non\-technical stakeholders.

Job Description:  

Alutiiq is hiring a Contractor Program Manager to lead operations and maintenance of the Ground\-based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) system for the 15th Space Surveillance Squadron under Mission Delta 2\. GEODSS detects, tracks, identifies, and reports on man\-made objects in Earth orbit, feeding the National Space Defense Center, the 18th Space Defense Squadron, and the National Space Intelligence Center. The system operates from three geographically separated detachments — Stallion Range at White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico, Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia, and Mount Haleakala on Maui — each running three one\-meter telescopes on a 24/7 basis, with mission operations conducted between civil sunset and sunrise.


You will be the single point of accountability to the Government Program Manager, Contracting Officer, and site Contracting Officer Representatives for the performance of the entire program. This is a designated key personnel position; the Government reviews and approves the qualifications package for this role, and any change to the incumbent requires a replacement package within seven days.

  


What You’ll Do
--------------


* Serve as the contractor’s single point of authority for GEODSS O\&M across all three detachments, reporting any problem affecting requirement accomplishment or contractor performance to the CORs, Government PM, and CO within one business day
* Own the program Management Plan — organizational structure, lines of authority, manning levels, position descriptions, qualification and certification requirements, training approach, work scheduling, and integration with the Quality Management Program
* Direct the three Site Managers and the program\-level functional leads for system administration, line tactics, environmental, civil engineering, weapon system maintenance, and logistics/transportation

**Overview**

This isn't a desk job; it's a front\-row seat to shaping how the U.S. military postures, moves, and sustains forces across the Pacific theater. As a Logistics Operations Analyst at Camp Smith, you'll translate complex engineering requirements and operational priorities into decisions that matter, delivering planning products and assessments directly to senior military and civilian leaders. You'll work at the intersection of joint logistics, engineering operations, and theater\-level planning, where your analysis drives real outcomes across a vast and contested region. If you thrive in high\-stakes environments and want your work to count, this is where you belong.

**THE MISSION**

The Pacific theater demands precision, adaptability, and deep operational know\-how. K2 is looking for a Logistics Operations Analyst to support a joint logistics and engineering organization at Camp Smith, Honolulu, HI. You'll analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, and logistics dependencies, then turn that analysis into actionable products for decision\-makers. From deliberate planning to real\-world contingency operations, your work directly supports theater readiness, force posture, and engineering integration across Service components and regional partners.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Analyze theater requirements, infrastructure constraints, access limitations, and logistics dependencies affecting engineering support across the Pacific
* Attend operational briefs, OPGs, planning sessions, and coordination meetings — independently capture decisions, taskings, risks, and follow\-up actions
* Translate engineering guidance and operational priorities into concise planning inputs, logistics assessments, staff products, and recommendations
* Coordinate with engineering, logistics, planning, and operations personnel across the joint force and Service components
* Support integration of engineering requirements into CONPLANs, OPLANs, contingency plans, exercise plans, and related operational products
* Assess the feasibility and supportability of force posture, basing, infrastructure, and sustainment concepts
* Develop briefings, decision papers, executive summaries, readiness updates, trackers, and other products for senior military and civilian leaders
* Support exercise operations and real\-world planning activities, including participation in a shift\-work environment when required
* Maintain planning processes, status trackers, readiness indicators, and reporting mechanisms that improve visibility of engineering and logistics requirements
* Provide lessons learned and post\-event recommendations to improve future planning and operational execution
* Plan, track, and coordinate movement of Class IV materials — sandbags, barbed wire, lumber, concrete, and comparable construction and barrier materials — through TRANSCOM, DLA, military distribution, or similar logistics channels
* Translate engineering requirements, including BDA, ADR, PDR, and FP considerations, into prioritized logistics assessments, movement actions, and clear operational briefings

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, logistics, operations research, architecture, military studies, national security studies, regional planning, or a related field
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in joint military planning, operational logistics, engineering operations, infrastructure assessment, force posture analysis, or defense planning support
* Demonstrated experience supporting DoD, Combatant Command, Service component, defense agency, or comparable military planning environments
* Working knowledge of joint planning processes, operational design, plan assessment, and staff integration across deliberate and crisis action planning
* Strong analytical and note\-taking skills, including the ability to understand construction properties and communicate technically accurate information to the broader team
* Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, particularly when attending briefs, OPGs, and other senior\-level planning forums
* Solid understanding of Pacific geography, regional access constraints, and the operating environment involving U.S. allies and partners
* Familiarity with joint operations, Priority of Effort, and the integration of engineering support across Service components
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and coordinate across diverse stakeholder groups
* Ability to work effectively in an exercise, contingency, or shift\-work environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common planning, collaboration, tracking, and data\-analysis tools
* Active TS/SCI eligibility

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Prior experience supporting U.S. Pacific Command, another Geographic Combatant Command, Joint Staff, Service component headquarters, or comparable theater\-level organization
* Experience with contingency engineering, crisis action teams, exercise planning cells, posture planning, infrastructure assessments, or theater logistics planning
* Experience working with allies, partners, host\-nation organizations, or interagency stakeholders in the Pacific region
* Joint Professional Military Education, engineer officer advanced schooling, or equivalent military planning education
* Professional Engineer license, project or program management credential, or process\-improvement certification
* Master's degree in engineering, logistics, operations research, systems engineering, national security affairs, public policy, or a related discipline

**WHY K2**

K2 is not a typical government contractor. We're an SBA 8(a) Native Hawaiian Organization built on a foundation of service, excellence, and mission focus. We put high\-performers in roles that demand their best, and we back them up with the resources, leadership, and culture to succeed. Our teams work on missions that shape national security outcomes. new_jobs.title: Program Analyst (BPM)
new_jobs.description:
The Department of Parks and Recreation is seeking a program analyst in the Division of Budget and Procurement Management. The incumbent provides analytical, operational, and advisory support for the agency’s budget, procurement, and performance management functions. The position monitors and reports on program budgets across multiple fund types (including operating, enterprise, and capital), procurement activity, compliance with the District’s Small and Certified Business Enterprise Program, and key performance indicators and other organizational performance metrics. The incumbent coordinates budget, procurement, and performance\-related activities across agency divisions, and serves as a liaison with District partners, including the Office of the Chief Financial Officer, Office of Contracting and Procurement, Department of Small and Local Business Development, and the Mayor’s Office of Budget and Performance Management. Through analysis, coordination, and strategic support, the position facilitates compliance with applicable District and federal requirements, supports informed decision\-making, and promotes effective stewardship of agency resources and operational performance.


**Duties and Responsibilities**


Performs duties and special assignments independently, exercising complete judgment within the purview of established rules, regulations, and policies of the DC Department of Parks and Recreation. Provides critical analyses and evaluations of actual or potential effectiveness of current and/or projected program activities. Provides technical assistance in the design, development and implementation of improved program designs/operations. Reviews and analyzes planning and operations activities of major program areas administered by the department. Conducts management surveys, audits, projects, etc., and provides advisory services to operating or management officials. Based upon the assessments made, it identifies actual or potential problem areas, trends, and/or areas of significant concerns. Develops, recommends and implements policies for corrective actions, necessary to remedy deficiencies in program areas. Plans, develops and implements a system for obtaining and providing data required by the agency/department for long\-range planning and projections and that which is needed for evaluation of day\-to\-day operations.


Develops cost analyses of projects, performs cost\-benefit or economic evaluations of current or projected program(s). Forecasts and estimates requirements, and prepares programmatic reports, justifications, charts, graphs, statistical and narrative data, etc. Conducts continuous review and analysis of current or proposed programs and related administrative and financial activities; determines, through comprehensive assessment, effective utilization of resources at program level; identifies program strengths and deficiencies; and recommends changes or corrective action relative to program design, policies, procedures, and operations. Meets with agency officials and managers to provide advice, guidance and technical assistance to programs in the development of review indicators.

**Qualifications and Education**


Specialized experience is experience which is directly related to the position and has equipped the individual with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position. To be creditable, the incumbent must possess at least one (1\) year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

**Licenses and Certifications**


None.

**Working Conditions/Environment**


The work is performed in an office setting involving everyday risks or discomforts, which require normal safety precautions typical of offices.

**Other Significant Facts**

**Tour of Duty:** Monday through Friday; 8:30 am – 5:30 pm. Shift work is required.

**Pay Plan, Series, and Grade:** CS\-0343\-13

**Duration of Appointment:** Career Service \- Regular

**Collective Bargaining Unit (Non\-Union):** This position is not covered under a Collective Bargaining Unit.

**Promotion Potential:**No known promotion potential

**Residency Preference:** When claiming residency preference, you are required, and must agree in writing, to maintain bona fide District residency for a period of seven (7\) consecutive years from the effective date of employment. You will be required to present documents (proofs) to show District residency and failure to maintain bona\-fide District residency for the seven\-year (7\-year) period will result in forfeiture of employment.

**Position Designation:** The position has been deemed **S****ecurity Sensitive**. Accordingly, the incumbent will be subject to pre\-employment checks (criminal background checks, consumer credit checks, traffic record checks, if applicable) as a condition of employment, and will be subject to periodic criminal background checks for the duration of your tenure.

**EEO Statement:**The District of Columbia Government does not discriminate or retaliate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, family responsibilities, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, homeless status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, participation in a legally protected activity, parental status, matriculation, personal appearance, credit information, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, sexual offense, or stalking, military service, or other non\-merit factor.

new_jobs.title: Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Thomasville Restoration's vision is to be the \#1 most trusted and respected restoration company.


**Pay:****$65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year**
-----------------------------------------------

**About Thomasville Restoration**
---------------------------------

To help achieve this goal and support our growth, we are adding an Operations Analyst.


As Thomasville continues to grow organically and through acquisition, having the right operational foundation is critical. Our ability to enter new markets, build strong partnerships, integrate new teams, implement the right technology, and create scalable processes will help determine how successfully we grow.


The Operations Analyst will help Thomasville build and maintain the operational infrastructure necessary to support continued growth. This person will serve as a connector between people, processes, technology, and growth, helping ensure that as Thomasville gets bigger, we also get better.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Help manage and maintain Thomasville’s operational readiness across current and future markets, including licenses, certifications, insurance requirements, registrations, and other operational requirements.
* Develop and maintain systems for tracking license and certification requirements, renewals, expirations, documentation, and compliance deadlines.
* Support Thomasville’s relationships and operational requirements with TPA partners, including onboarding requirements, credentials, certifications, documentation, program requirements, and ongoing readiness.
* Identify operational requirements necessary to enter new markets, add new service lines, and expand existing operations.
* Support company growth initiatives through organic expansion and acquisitions.
* Help develop and execute integration plans for acquired companies, including people, processes, systems, technology, documentation, operational standards, and TPA relationships.
* Analyze existing workflows and processes to identify gaps, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Work across departments to develop, document, implement, and continuously improve scalable operational processes and standard operating procedures.
* Support the implementation and adoption of new systems through process development, training, documentation, communication, and change management.
* Research industry trends, TPA requirements, operational best practices, technology solutions, and other opportunities that can help Thomasville operate more effectively.
* Help turn leadership’s strategic initiatives into organized, measurable, executable plans.
* Continually look for ways Thomasville can simplify processes, improve accountability, increase efficiency, and scale successfully.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You have at least 4 years of progressive work experience in the insurance restoration industry.
* You’re analytical, organized, and naturally curious about how businesses operate and how they can operate better.
* You enjoy taking complicated problems and turning them into clear, manageable processes.
* You understand that successful operations require the right combination of people, processes, technology, and accountability.
* You are comfortable working with data and translating information into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
* You are highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects, requirements, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* You enjoy working across departments and can communicate effectively with both leadership and team members.
* You have an interest in business growth, operational scalability, acquisitions, and integration.
* You understand that technology is an important operational tool, but successful implementation depends on having the right processes and people behind it.
* You are proactive and take ownership. You don’t just identify a problem; you help develop and implement the solution.
* You want to be part of a leadership\-driven, values\-focused, rapidly growing company.

**Your Impact**
---------------


Your work will help Thomasville maintain operational readiness, improve processes, support new market expansion, and successfully integrate new companies, teams, systems, and processes as we grow.

new_jobs.title: Program Analyst - Strategic Engagement
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities:
**Program Overview:**


Noblis is positioned to provide technology and operational solutions to senior decision makers in the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in the Science and Technology (S\&T) Directorate. The DHS S\&T Directorate is the primary research and development arm of DHS and manages science and technology research, from development through transition, for the Department's operational components and first responders. Established by Congress to provide innovative solutions to the nation's homeland security challenges, S\&T is the core source of scientific and engineering expertise for DHS and is uniquely postured to enhance our nation's security and resilience by providing knowledge products and innovative technology solutions for the Homeland Security Enterprise (HSE).  

  

At Noblis and Noblis ESI, we have excellent teams of smart, collaborative, proactive experts and professionals. We are actively seeking to identify personnel to join our team of talented professionals who possess the experience, vision, commitment, and integrity to successfully support the S\&T mission.

 **Responsibilities:**


The Strategic Events Analyst will provide analytical, planning, and operations support to a front office organization within the Department of Homeland Security's (DHS) Science \& Technology Directorate (S\&T). This organization is responsible for planning and executing senior\-level and strategic engagements across industry, interagency, international, Congressional, and intelligence community partners across all homeland security science and technology mission areas.  

This position will conduct end\-to\-end planning and coordination for external engagements outside the National Capital Region, analyzing and advising the proper sequencing of events to meet strategic goals. The analyst will provide solutions for complex scheduling, budgetary, and logistical problems that require in\-depth knowledge of federal travel regulations and DHS operational policies and conduct financial analysis of travel expenditures resulting in data\-driven optimization of travel operations. This position applies analytical methodologies to streamline travel processes, identify cost efficiencies, and ensure leadership travel aligns with the office’s strategic engagement priorities. The analyst will evaluate travel patterns, develop planning frameworks, and produce actionable recommendations that maximize the impact of senior leader engagements across industry, interagency, international, and congressional stakeholders.  

The successful candidate will be self\-motivated, operate well in a matrixed environment, effectively manage competing priorities, and be comfortable exercising independent judgment in communication with external stakeholders and senior leadership. This individual must be proactive—comfortable proposing process improvements, identifying efficiencies, and personally owning execution from concept through delivery. **This is currently a hybrid position with a blend of on\-site and remote work, requiring staff to be on\-site at the DHS S\&T client site in Washington D.C. as needed. Applicants must be able to regularly commute to Washington D.C.**  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:* Analyzing travel expenditure data to identify cost trends, forecast budget requirements, and develop recommendations on cost\-optimization strategies for front office travel operations.
* Coordinating end\-to\-end travel logistics for front office leadership, including itinerary development, transportation, lodging, and venue arrangements for domestic and international engagements.
* Developing and maintaining travel planning frameworks, templates, and standard operating procedures to institutionalize efficient travel coordination processes.
* Producing financial analyses and summary reports on travel spending, comparing actuals to budget allocations and flagging variances for leadership review.
* Conducting pre\-trip research and analysis on engagement venues, stakeholder organizations, and logistical considerations to inform leadership preparation and maximize engagement outcomes.
* Tracking and analyzing travel metrics (e.g., cost\-per\-trip, lead times, cancellation rates) to identify process improvements and brief findings to front office leadership.
* Coordinating with external stakeholders, government travel offices, and vendors to resolve logistical issues and ensure compliance with federal travel regulations (FTR) and DHS travel policies.
* Supporting the development of trip\-specific briefing materials, including background research on meeting participants, organizational profiles, and engagement objectives.
* Maintaining and analyzing an integrated travel and engagement calendar to identify scheduling conflicts, optimize leadership availability, and align travel with strategic engagement priorities.
* Assisting with after\-action data collection from leadership engagements, synthesizing feedback and travel outcomes to inform future planning and resource allocation decisions.


Required Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s Degree with 5\+ years of related experience or Master’s Degree with 3\+ years of related experience.
* Eligibility to obtain a Secret Clearance and DHS Suitability determination.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources into clear, actionable briefing materials.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to assess competing priorities, evaluate stakeholder equities, and recommend courses of action.

Desired Qualifications:
* Experience coordinating travel logistics in a federal government or government contracting environment.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct financial analysis, including budget tracking, variance analysis, and cost forecasting.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI) for travel metrics reporting and visualizatio

new_jobs.title: Program Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Nakupuna Consulting is looking to hire a Program Analyst to help support our Navy Bureau of Medicine \& Surgery (BUMED) BUILDER DMLSS/LogiCole Readiness Support Project Team (Team Nakupuna). The candidate will report directly to our Program Manager (PM) and be responsible for the successful execution of the project and provide overall management support of Team Nakupuna staff ensuring alignment, growth, and exceptional client support.

  

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this position, but management may assign additional duties and responsibilities at any time. Specific duties include:

* Provides support for BUMED medical readiness facility portfolio to include building queries, reports, and analysis of data from Naval Facilities Systems Engineering Command’s (NAVFAC) and/or Marine Corps MAXIMO and eProjects systems to track the status of work and projects related to BUMED’s facility portfolio.
* Assist the PM with analysis and formatting of data supporting preparation of recurring and other deliverables.
* Support BUMED Headquarters and Regional staff with analysis and documents to answer facility\-related requests for information from BUMED leadership staff and other stakeholders as requested.
* Provide Subject Matter Expertise and analysis to support BUMED Facility Management\-related financial and planning activities such as annual enterprise Maintenance Action Plans, Program Objective Memorandum, and Special Projects Board.
* Provide support to BUMED Headquarters and Regional staff with expertise and analysis of key Real Property data repositories, documents, and systems such as the Facility Sustainment Model, Data Analysis and Integration Support (DAIS) Platform, Asset Reporting Management System (ARMS), Business Intelligence and Business Common System for DMLSS\-FM and LogiCole.
* Execute (as directed by the PM) DMLSS\-FM/LogiCole facility record updates, additions, and removals with approval from the BUMED Headquarters Real Property Officer.
* Provide support for BUMED commands with evaluation of Facility Management instructions and other guiding documents from DoD, Navy, DHA, and BUMED as requested.
* Responsible for the professionalism, timeliness, and quality of all contract performance requirements and deliverables.

 **Skills/Qualifications:** The ideal candidate for the Program Management Analyst position must possess strong leadership and organizational skills, with a proven track record in program support within a similar domain. They should have comprehensive knowledge of DMLSS\-FM, BUILDER, iNFADS, and other CMMS systems like NAVFAC MAXIMO and NAVFAC eProjects. Familiarity with performing analysis and using software for reporting (examples MS Lists, PowerBI, MS Excel). The candidate must be adept at coordinating complex tasks and activities across multiple regions and divisions, demonstrating exceptional communication skills to effectively liaise with government representatives, contractors, and various stakeholders. Expertise in developing and implementing contract management plans, quality control processes, and performance metrics is essential. The ability to provide effective training and support, both on\-site and remotely, is crucial. Additionally, the candidate should have strong analytical skills to evaluate business processes and implement efficient automated solutions. Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and maintaining comprehensive documentation is required, along with the flexibility to travel as necessary and manage multiple projects concurrently. A background in facilities management and familiarity with Navy Medicine operations will be highly advantageous.

**Education \& Experience:** This position requires a minimum of 5 years of professional experience. The ideal candidate will have an advanced degree or comparative years of professional experience in project management, or a similar field.

**Clearance Requirements:** Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain a government\-issued CAC and possess a Secret security clearance.

**Physical Requirements:** The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job ***with or without*** ***a reasonable*** ***accommodation****:*

* Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
* Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
* Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.

  

The Nakupuna Companies use a market\-based compensation strategy to ensure that our employees are compensated within applicable market ranges commensurate with multiple factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract\-specific affordability, organizational requirements, and position location. The projected compensation range for this position is $90,000\.00 to $95,000\.00 (annualized USD). The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Nakupuna Companies total compensation package for employees.

Program Director NewGen PA
\_\_
